\newpage

## Import data
```{r}
phosphate_mw = 94.9714
phosphorous_mw = 30.97362

urine_ma <- fread("24_hr_urine_ma_12082025.csv", header = TRUE) %>% janitor::clean_names()

hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary <- fread("24_hr_urine_ma_nhs_hpfs_data.csv", header = TRUE) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    phosphate_mean_mmol_24h = phosphorus_mean_mg_24h / phosphorous_mw,
    phosphate_sd_mmol_24h = phosphorus_sd_mg_24h / phosphorous_mw,
    .keep = "all"
  )

#these are excluded as phosphate/phosphorous definition is either unclear or unit conversion is not accurate
phosphate_to_exclude <- list("Bataille",  # Outlier - unclear if PO4 or P being used
                           "Huang", # Reported as phosphate (g/24 hr) but no methods defined, all other reference to phosphate / phosphorous is "P"
                           "Doizi", # Reported as phosphorous but methods use phosphate determination method
                           "Wabner", # Reported as phosphate (g/24 hr) but no methods defined
                           "Miyake", # Reported in phosphate mg/ml - not able to convert accurately
                           "Sweeney" # No methods of determination reported
                           )

phosphate_phosphorous <- fread("phosphate_phosphorous_updated_separated.csv", header = TRUE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(!authors %in% phosphate_to_exclude) %>%
  filter(calculated_from_vol != "Y")


```
\newpage

## Import and Sort Bias analysis
```{r}
bias_observational <- fread("cochrane_risk_observational_studies.csv", header = TRUE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

bias_rcts <- fread("cochrane_risk_rct.csv", header = TRUE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
    mutate(overall = case_when(overall_risk_of_bias_low_some_concern_high == "Some concern" ~ "Moderate",
                               overall_risk_of_bias_low_some_concern_high == "High" ~ "High",
                               overall_risk_of_bias_low_some_concern_high == "Low" ~ "Low",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_),
           .keep = "unused")

overall_bias <- bias_observational %>% 
  subset(select = c(study, overall)) %>%
  rbind(bias_rcts %>% subset(select = c(
    study, overall
  )) 
  ) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(study_name = study,
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  drop_na(overall)

overall_bias$overall <- factor(overall_bias$overall,
                               levels = c("Low",
                                          "Moderate",
                                          "High"))
```
\newpage

## Sort data
### Phosphate data
```{r}
phosphate_phosphorous <- phosphate_phosphorous %>%
  mutate(
    phosphate_mean_mmol_24h = case_when(
      !is.na(phosphate_mean_mmol_24h) ~ phosphate_mean_mmol_24h,
      !is.na(phosphate_mean_mg_24h) ~ phosphate_mean_mg_24h / phosphate_mw, 
      !is.na(phosphate_mean_g_24h) ~ (phosphate_mean_g_24h / phosphate_mw) * 1000,
      !is.na(phosphorus_mean_mg_24h) ~ phosphorus_mean_mg_24h / phosphorous_mw
    ), 
    phosphate_sd_mmol_24h = case_when(
      !is.na(phosphate_sd_mmol_24h) ~ phosphate_sd_mmol_24h,
      !is.na(phosphate_sd_mg_24h) ~ phosphate_sd_mg_24h / phosphate_mw,
      !is.na(phosphate_sd_g_24h) ~ (phosphate_sd_g_24h / phosphate_mw) * 1000,
      !is.na(phosphorus_sd_mg_24h) ~ phosphorus_sd_mg_24h / phosphorous_mw
    ),
    .keep = "unused"
    ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    authors, 
    year, 
    phosphate_mean_mmol_24h, 
    phosphate_sd_mmol_24h)
```

### MA data
```{r}
hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary1 <- hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary %>%
  subset(
    select = -c(
      assay,
      comments,
      phosphate_mean_mmol_24h,
      phosphate_sd_mmol_24h,
      phosphorus_mean_mg_24h,
      phosphorus_sd_mg_24h
    )
  )

hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary2 <- hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary %>%
  subset(
    select = c(
      phosphate_mean_mmol_24h,
      phosphate_sd_mmol_24h,
      phosphorus_mean_mg_24h,
      phosphorus_sd_mg_24h
    )
  )

hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary <- hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary1 %>%
  cbind(hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary2) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(phosphorus_mean_mg_24h, phosphorus_sd_mg_24h))

urine_ma1 <- urine_ma %>%
  select(-starts_with("x")) %>%
  subset(select = -c(phosphate_mean_mmol_24h, phosphate_sd_mmol_24h)) %>%
  mutate(join_key = paste0(first_author, year)) %>%
  left_join(
    phosphate_phosphorous %>% mutate(join_key = paste0(authors, year), 
                                     .keep = "unused"),
    by = "join_key"
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(join_key, comments, ok_measurement)) %>%
  rbind(hpfs_nhs_I_II_summary) %>%
  cbind(urine_ma %>% select(ok_measurement))



urine_ma1$age_sd <- as.numeric(urine_ma1$age_sd)
urine_ma1$child_adult <- as.factor(urine_ma1$child_adult)
urine_ma1$underlying_cause <- as.factor(urine_ma1$underlying_cause)
urine_ma1$stone_vs_no_stone <- as.factor(urine_ma1$stone_vs_no_stone)
urine_ma1$ok_measurement <- as.factor(urine_ma1$ok_measurement)
urine_ma1$male_n <- as.integer(urine_ma1$male_n)
urine_ma1$female_n <- as.integer(urine_ma1$female_n)
urine_ma1$ph_mean <- as.numeric(urine_ma1$ph_mean)
urine_ma1$ph_sd <- as.numeric(urine_ma1$ph_sd)
urine_ma1$volume_mean_m_l <- as.numeric(urine_ma1$volume_mean_m_l)
urine_ma1$total_n <- as.integer(urine_ma1$total_n)
urine_ma1$restricted_diet <- as.factor(urine_ma1$restricted_diet)
urine_ma1$other_demographic_variant <- as.factor(urine_ma1$other_demographic_variant)

urine_ma1 <- urine_ma1 %>% mutate(
  urea_mean_mmol_24h = ifelse(urea_mean_mmol_24h < 1,
                              urea_mean_mmol_24h * 1000,
                              urea_mean_mmol_24h),
  urea_sd_mmol_24h = ifelse(urea_sd_mmol_24h < 1,
                              urea_sd_mmol_24h * 1000,
                              urea_sd_mmol_24h),
)

urine_ma1 <- urine_ma1 %>% mutate(
  study_name = case_when(
    first_author == "HPFS & NHS I/II" ~ first_author,
    and == "no" & first_author != "HPFS & NHS I/II" ~ paste0(first_author, " et al. ", year),
    and == "yes" ~ paste0(first_author, ", ", year),
  TRUE ~ paste0(first_author, " et al. ", year)),
  underlying_cause = case_when(
        other_demographic_variant == "pre_menopausal" ~ "pre_menopausal",
        other_demographic_variant == "post_menopausal" ~ "post_menopausal",
        TRUE ~ other_demographic_variant
  ),
  other_demographic_variant = case_when(
    other_demographic_variant == "black" ~ "black",
    other_demographic_variant == "white" ~ "white",
    other_demographic_variant == "no" ~ "mixed",
    other_demographic_variant == "pre_menopausal" ~ "mixed",
    other_demographic_variant == "post_menopausal" ~ "mixed"
  ),
  .keep = "all"
)

urine_ma1$other_demographic_variant <- as.factor(urine_ma1$other_demographic_variant)

urine_ma2 <- urine_ma1 %>%
  filter(
    stone_vs_no_stone == "no_stone") %>%
  filter(
      (underlying_cause == "no" |
        underlying_cause == "pre_menopausal")) %>%
  filter(!first_author %in% c("Prochaska", "Ferraro", "Curhan", "Taylor and Curhan")) %>%
  drop_na(total_n)

urine_ma2 <- urine_ma2 %>% 
  mutate(
    age_band = case_when(
      age_band == "20-29" | age_band == "20-30" ~ "20-30",
      age_band == "30-39" | age_band == "30-40" ~ "30-40",
      age_band == "40-49" | age_band == "40-50" ~ "40-50",
      age_band == "50-59" | age_band == "50-60" ~ "50-60",
      age_band == "60-70" | age_band == "60+" | age_band == "70-80" ~ "60+",
      TRUE ~ age_band
    ),
    study_type = case_when(
      study_name %in% bias_observational$study ~ "Observational Cohort",
      study_name %in% bias_rcts$study ~ "RCT",
      TRUE ~ "Observational Cohort"
    )
  )

urine_ma2$race <- as.factor(urine_ma2$race)
urine_ma2$male_female <- as.factor(urine_ma2$male_female)
urine_ma2$age_band <- as.factor(urine_ma2$age_band)

study_types <- urine_ma2 %>% dplyr::select(study_name, study_type)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A5 — Assay-method lookup (per study × component)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generated by `assay_extraction.R` from `24_hr_urine_ma_12082025_2.xlsx` Rob
# sheet, column `ascertainment_of_measurements`. Free text was parsed into
# broad assay categories (atomic absorption / autoanalyser / ion chromatography
# / etc.) per analyte. Studies known to use chemical preservatives (Litholink,
# Mission Pharmacal, Labcorp, acidification with HCl) are flagged.
study_assay_lookup <- tryCatch({
  readRDS("shiny_app_data/study_assay_lookup.rds")
}, error = function(e) {
  message("study_assay_lookup.rds not found — run assay_extraction.R first.")
  NULL
})

# Helper to merge assay categories into a per-component analysis dataset.
# `data` should be the standard urine_ma2-style data; `urine_component` is
# one of "calcium", "oxalate", ... matched to the assay lookup component.
add_assay_column <- function(data, urine_component) {
  if (is.null(study_assay_lookup)) {
    data$assay_cat <- NA_character_
    data$preservative_used <- NA
    return(data)
  }
  comp_key <- if (urine_component == "creat") "creatinine" else urine_component
  comp_lookup <- study_assay_lookup %>%
    dplyr::filter(component == comp_key) %>%
    dplyr::select(study_name, assay_cat, preservative_used)
  dplyr::left_join(data, comp_lookup, by = "study_name") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay_cat = ifelse(is.na(assay_cat), "Unreported", assay_cat),
      preservative_used = ifelse(is.na(preservative_used), FALSE, preservative_used)
    )
}

## Number of Papers in MA

urine_ma2 %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(first_author)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Number of Studies**")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = "white",
    table.border.bottom.color = "white",
    data_row.padding = px(8),
    table.font.size = 14
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  )
```

## Table of Papers Included in Review
```{r}
urine_ma1 %>% 
  arrange(year) %>%
  drop_na(year) %>%
  mutate(first_author = case_when(
    and == "no" ~ paste0(first_author, ", ", year),
    first_author == "HPFS" | first_author == "NHS" ~ first_author,
    TRUE ~ paste0(first_author, " et al. ", year)
  )) %>%
  group_by(first_author) %>%
  select(first_author,
         stone_vs_no_stone,
         underlying_cause,
         other_demographic_variant,
         mean_age,
         age_sd,
         total_n,
         male_n,
         female_n) %>% 
  gt() %>%
  gt_theme_espn() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Summary of Included Full Texts**")
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.font.size = px(14),
    data_row.padding = px(10)
  )
```

## Summary table of Included patients
```{r}
mean_age_summary <- urine_ma2 %>% 
  mutate(first_author = ifelse(
    and == "no",
    paste0(first_author, " et al. ", year),
    paste0(first_author, ", ", year)
  )) %>%
  metamean(
    n = total_n,
    mean = mean_age,
    sd = age_sd,
    studlab = study_name
  )

urine_ma2 %>% 
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(first_author = ifelse(
    and == "no",
    paste0(first_author, " et al. ", year),
    paste0(first_author, ", ", year)
  )) %>%
  select(total_n, male_n, female_n, first_author) %>%
  summarise(
    "Total Papers, n" = n_distinct(first_author),
    "Total Patients, n" = sum(total_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Male Patients, n" = sum(male_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Female Patients, n" = sum(female_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Mean Age, years ± SD" = paste0(
      round(mean_age_summary$TE.random),
      " ± ",
      round(mean_age_summary$seTE.random)
    )
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt_theme_espn() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Summary of Included Studies for MA**"),
    subtitle = "Only non kidney stone forming patients included in analysis"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.font.size = px(14),
    data_row.padding = px(10)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Some studies only provided a total number of patients, rather than subdividing by sex",
    locations = cells_column_labels(
      columns = c("Male Patients, n", "Female Patients, n")
    ),
    placement = "right"
  )

```

## Visualise current expected ranges
```{r}
current_ref_plot_data <- current_ref_range %>%
  # Filter out rows where both limits are missing
  filter(!is.na(lower_limit) | !is.na(upper_limit)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Determine the type of limit
    limit_type = case_when(
      !is.na(lower_limit) & !is.na(upper_limit) ~ "range",
      !is.na(lower_limit) & is.na(upper_limit) ~ "lower_only", 
      is.na(lower_limit) & !is.na(upper_limit) ~ "upper_only"
    ),
    # Clean up component names
    urine_component = case_when(
      urine_component == "creatinine_overall" ~ "Creatinine (Overall)",
      urine_component == "creatinine_men" ~ "Creatinine (Men)",  
      urine_component == "creatinine_women" ~ "Creatinine (Women)",
      urine_component == "volume" ~ "Volume",
      urine_component == "ph" ~ "pH",
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", urine_component))
    ),
    # Create display value for ordering (use available limit)
    display_value = case_when(
      limit_type == "range" ~ (lower_limit + upper_limit) / 2,
      limit_type == "lower_only" ~ lower_limit,
      limit_type == "upper_only" ~ upper_limit
    )
  )

# Create source ordering based on overall display values
source_order <- current_ref_plot_data %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(avg_display = mean(display_value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(avg_display) %>%
  pull(source)

# Apply ordering
current_ref_plot_data <- current_ref_plot_data %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = source_order))

# Create the forest plot with faceting by urine_component
forest_plot_current_ref_ranges <- current_ref_plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = source, color = source)) +
  
  # Two-sided ranges (traditional error bars)
  geom_errorbarh(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "range"),
                 aes(xmin = lower_limit, xmax = upper_limit), 
                 height = 0.3, size = 1.2) +
  
  # Points for midpoint of ranges
  geom_point(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "range"),
             aes(x = display_value), size = 0) +
  
  # Lower limit only - left arrow
  geom_segment(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "lower_only"),
               aes(x = lower_limit * 0.8, xend = lower_limit, 
                   y = source, yend = source),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.01, "cm"), type = "closed", ends = "last"),
               size = 1.2) +
  
  # Upper limit only - right arrow  
  geom_segment(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "upper_only"),
               aes(x = upper_limit, xend = upper_limit * 1.2,
                   y = source, yend = source), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.01, "cm"), type = "closed", ends = "first"),
               size = 1.2) +
  
  # Points for one-sided limits
  geom_point(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type %in% c("lower_only", "upper_only")),
             aes(x = display_value), size = 0) +
  
  # Text labels for ranges
  geom_text(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "range"),
            aes(x = upper_limit * 1.1, 
                label = paste0("[", round(lower_limit, 1), " - ", round(upper_limit, 1), "]")),
            size = 2.5, hjust = 0, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Text labels for lower only
  geom_text(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "lower_only"),
            aes(x = lower_limit * 1.1, 
                label = paste0("> ", round(lower_limit, 1))),
            size = 2.5, hjust = 0, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Text labels for upper only  
  geom_text(data = filter(current_ref_plot_data, limit_type == "upper_only"),
            aes(x = upper_limit * 1.1,
                label = paste0("< ", round(upper_limit, 1))),
            size = 2.5, hjust = 0, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Facet by urine_component
  facet_wrap(~ urine_component, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  
  # Formatting
  labs(title = "Current Expected Ranges for 24-Hour Urine Components",
       subtitle = "Comparison across clinical guidelines (arrows indicate one-sided limits)",
       x = "Reference Values (Log Scale)", 
       y = "Source",
       color = "Source",
       caption = "Arrows (←) indicate 'greater than' limits; Arrows (→) indicate 'less than' limits") +
  
  # Use log scale
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma(),
                n.breaks = 10,
                limits = c(0.08, 350)) + 
  
  # Color scheme
  scale_color_manual(values = c("EAU" = "orange", 
                               "Mayo Clinic" = "black", 
                               "NHS" = "darkblue",
                               "Litholink" = "cyan2")) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray60"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray60", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none",  # Remove legend since colors identify sources
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 80, 5.5, 5.5, "pt")
  )

forest_plot_current_ref_ranges

summary_table_data <- current_ref_plot_data %>%
  select(urine_component, source, lower_limit, upper_limit, limit_type) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create formatted range column
    range_text = case_when(
      limit_type == "range" ~ paste0(round(lower_limit, 1), " - ", round(upper_limit, 1)),
      limit_type == "lower_only" ~ paste0("> ", round(lower_limit, 1)),

  gt() %>%
  tab_header(

  cols_label(
    urine_component = "Urine Component"

  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),

  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),

  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),

    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(13),

  cols_align(
    align = "center",

  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = urine_component
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = seq(2, nrow(summary_table_data), 2))
  )

# Flow Diagram detailing Decision Making {.tabset .tabset-pills}

## Decision Framework — Rationale Logic

The framework below codifies the decision logic used to recommend a specific
analysis (overall pooled, sex-stratified, meta-regression, or low risk-of-bias
sub-analysis) for each urine component. All thresholds are stored in a single
`THRESHOLDS` list so they can be inspected and adjusted in one place.

```{r decision_thresholds}
# Codified decision thresholds — see `recommend_analysis()` below
THRESHOLDS <- list(
  k_min           = 5,    # min studies for a stratum to be "powered"
  n_min           = 500,  # min participants for a stratum to be "powered"
  R2_min          = 0.10, # min meta-regression R^2 to prefer over pooled (Q6)
  R2_q6c_min      = 0.10, # min meta-regression R² for Q6c to fire — if R² is
                          # below this AND meta-reg point estimate is near the
                          # overall pooled estimate, the regression adds nothing
                          # over the simpler pooled estimate (Occam's razor)
  mr_diff_min     = 0.05, # min relative difference between meta-reg and overall
                          # pooled estimates for Q6c to fire when R² < R2_q6c_min
                          # (i.e. meta-reg gets a chance even with low R² if its
                          # point estimate is meaningfully different from pooled)
  R2_k_min        = 20,   # min studies for Q6 to be testable (Bridge 3 — k floor
                          # to prevent saturated models with implausibly high R²)
  eggers_alpha    = 0.10, # significance threshold for Egger's small-study bias
                          # (Bridge 4 — fires Q6b: meta-regression as adjustment)
  wald_alpha      = 0.05, # significance threshold for between-group differences
  consistency_pct = 0.20, # max relative shift for "Low-RoB consistent with overall"
                          # also reused as min relative shift in Q5 assay test
  # Quality-gate thresholds (applied to every accepted Q before acceptance):
  q_ratio_max     = 1.5,  # chosen analysis's Cochran's Q / df ratio may not
                          # exceed overall's Q/df by more than 50%. Q/df = 1
                          # under no heterogeneity; ratio is k-independent so
                          # it lets us compare analyses with different study
                          # counts. Replaces I² (which is precision-dependent).
  rob_delta_max   = 0.20  # chosen analysis's high-RoB proportion may exceed the
                          # overall's by at most 20 percentage points; protects
                          # against branches enriched in poor-quality evidence.
)
```

```{r decision_flow_diagram, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Figure 1. Sequential decision logic for selecting the recommended analysis per urine component. The framework first checks data sufficiency (Q1), then sequentially tests for robust differences by sex (Q2), age band (Q3), race (Q4), and assay/country (Q5) before considering meta-regression (Q6) and low risk-of-bias (Q7) refinements. Each Yes branch triggers a stratified or refined recommendation; the default is the overall pooled meta-analysis. Assay/country is also included as a moderator in the meta-regression."}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DiagrammeR)
  library(DiagrammeRsvg)
  library(rsvg)
})

build_flow_diagram <- function() {
  grViz("
  digraph decision_framework {

    graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB, fontname = Helvetica,
           splines = ortho, nodesep = 0.35, ranksep = 0.5]
    node  [fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 11]
    edge  [fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 10]

    # ============ NODES ============
    start [label = 'For each\\nurine component',
           shape = oval, style = filled, fillcolor = '#3c8dbc',
           fontcolor = white, fontsize = 13, penwidth = 2]

    q_data [label = 'Q1. Sufficient data overall?\\nk ≥ 5 studies\\nAND n ≥ 500 participants',
            shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_sex  [label = 'Q2. Robust between-sex difference?\\n(a) women_prop coef p < 0.05 in main meta-regression\\nOR\\n(b) sex Wald p < 0.05 in ≥ 2 of 3 tiers\\n   (overall / meta-reg / low-RoB),\\n   AND ≥ 1 of these is overall or meta-reg\\n+ adequate power per sex (k ≥ 5, n ≥ 500)',
            shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_age  [label = 'Q3. Robust between-age-band difference?\\nany pairwise Wald p < 0.05 across age bands\\n+ ≥ 2 powered age bands (k ≥ 5, n ≥ 500)',
            shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_race [label = 'Q4. Robust between-race difference?\\nany pairwise Wald p < 0.05 across race groups\\n+ ≥ 2 powered race groups',
            shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_assay [label = 'Q5. Robust between-assay/country difference?\\nany pairwise Wald p < 0.05 across NAMED categories\\n(Unreported excluded)\\n+ relative shift ≥ 20% between categories\\n+ ≥ 2 powered categories (k ≥ 3 each)',
             shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_reg  [label = 'Q6. Meta-regression\\nexplains heterogeneity?\\nR² ≥ 10%\\nAND k ≥ 20 (sanity floor)',
            shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_egger [label = 'Q6b. Small-study bias\\ndetected?\\nEgger\\'s p < 0.10\\n(meta-regression as adjustment)',
             shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_noeffect [label = 'Q6c. All stratum tests negative\\nAND meta-reg adds value?\\n• range valid (lower 95%% > 0)\\n• k ≥ 20\\n• EITHER R² ≥ 10% OR\\n  meta-reg ≠ overall by ≥ 5%',
                shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    q_rob  [label = 'Q7. Low risk-of-bias subset:\\ntighter interval AND\\nconsistent with overall (≤ 20% shift)?',
            shape = diamond, style = filled, fillcolor = '#fff3cd', penwidth = 1.5]

    # ============ OUTCOMES ============
    o_insuff [label = 'OUTCOME 1\\nInsufficient data\\n(report overall pooled\\nwith caveats)',
              shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#dc3545',
              fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_sex [label = 'OUTCOME 2\\nSex-stratified\\nmain result',
           shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#17a2b8',
           fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_age [label = 'OUTCOME 3\\nAge-stratified\\nmain result',
           shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#0dcaf0',
           fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_race [label = 'OUTCOME 4\\nRace-stratified\\nmain result',
            shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#20c997',
            fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_assay [label = 'OUTCOME 5\\nAssay/country-\\nstratified result',
             shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#0d6efd',
             fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_reg [label = 'OUTCOME 6\\nMeta-regression\\nresult\\n(covariate-adjusted)',
           shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#28a745',
           fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_egger [label = 'OUTCOME 6b\\nMeta-regression\\n(small-study bias\\nadjustment)',
             shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#198754',
             fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_noeffect [label = 'OUTCOME 6c\\nMeta-regression\\n(no stratum effect;\\nrange valid)',
                shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#198754',
                fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_rob [label = 'OUTCOME 7\\nLow risk-of-bias\\noverall\\n(conservative)',
           shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#6f42c1',
           fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    o_pool [label = 'OUTCOME 8\\nOverall pooled\\n(default fallback)',
            shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fillcolor = '#fd7e14',
            fontcolor = white, fontsize = 11, penwidth = 1.5]

    # ============ EDGES ============
    start   -> q_data
    q_data  -> o_insuff [label = 'No',  color = '#dc3545']
    q_data  -> q_sex    [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_sex   -> o_sex    [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_sex   -> q_age    [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_age   -> o_age    [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_age   -> q_race   [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_race  -> o_race   [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_race  -> q_assay  [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_assay -> o_assay  [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_assay -> q_reg    [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_reg     -> o_reg       [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_reg     -> q_egger     [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_egger   -> o_egger     [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_egger   -> q_noeffect  [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_noeffect -> o_noeffect [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_noeffect -> q_rob      [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
    q_rob     -> o_rob       [label = 'Yes', color = '#28a745']
    q_rob     -> o_pool      [label = 'No',  color = '#6c757d']
  }
  ")
}

# Render and save for the paper
diag <- build_flow_diagram()
svg  <- export_svg(diag)
writeLines(svg, "decision_framework.svg")
rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg), file = "decision_framework.png", width = 1400)
rsvg_pdf(charToRaw(svg), file = "decision_framework.pdf")

# Display inline in the knitted Rmd
knitr::include_graphics("decision_framework.png")
```

## recommend_analysis() Function

```{r recommend_analysis_function}
# Wald test for difference between two pooled means using their pooled SDs
sex_wald_p <- function(mean_m, sd_m, mean_f, sd_f) {
  if (any(is.na(c(mean_m, sd_m, mean_f, sd_f)))) return(NA_real_)
  z <- (mean_m - mean_f) / sqrt(sd_m^2 + sd_f^2)
  2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
}

# Convenience predicates that handle both the in-Rmd naming scheme
# (sex_group ∈ {"main meta-analysis", "male", "female"}; age_band ∈ {"overall",
# "20-30", ..., "meta-regression"}) AND the precalculated/Shiny scheme
# (sex_group ∈ {"all", ...}; age_band ∈ {"all", ...}).
is_all_sexes  <- function(x) tolower(as.character(x)) %in%
                                c("all", "main meta-analysis", "main_meta_analysis")
is_overall_age <- function(x) tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c("all", "overall")
is_metareg_age <- function(x) tolower(as.character(x)) %in%
                                c("meta-regression", "meta_regression")

# Compute sex Wald p across analysis tiers (overall, meta-reg, Low-RoB) using
# rows from `all_ma_results` for one component.
sex_wald_across_tiers <- function(component, ma_long) {
  comp_data <- ma_long %>%
    filter(urine_component == component)

  # Overall (All Studies, overall age band)
  m_overall <- comp_data %>% filter(sex_group == "male",
                                    is_overall_age(age_band),
                                    quality_filter == "All Studies")
  f_overall <- comp_data %>% filter(sex_group == "female",
                                    is_overall_age(age_band),
                                    quality_filter == "All Studies")
  p_overall <- if (nrow(m_overall) >= 1 && nrow(f_overall) >= 1) {
    sex_wald_p(m_overall$pooled_estimate[1], m_overall$pooled_sd[1],
               f_overall$pooled_estimate[1], f_overall$pooled_sd[1])
  } else NA_real_

  # Meta-regression (within each sex)
  m_mr <- comp_data %>% filter(sex_group == "male",
                               is_metareg_age(age_band),
                               quality_filter == "All Studies")
  f_mr <- comp_data %>% filter(sex_group == "female",
                               is_metareg_age(age_band),
                               quality_filter == "All Studies")
  p_metareg <- if (nrow(m_mr) >= 1 && nrow(f_mr) >= 1) {
    sex_wald_p(m_mr$pooled_estimate[1], m_mr$pooled_sd[1],
               f_mr$pooled_estimate[1], f_mr$pooled_sd[1])
  } else NA_real_

  # Low risk-of-bias only
  m_lrob <- comp_data %>% filter(sex_group == "male",
                                 is_overall_age(age_band),
                                 quality_filter == "Low Risk of Bias Only")
  f_lrob <- comp_data %>% filter(sex_group == "female",
                                 is_overall_age(age_band),
                                 quality_filter == "Low Risk of Bias Only")
  p_lowrob <- if (nrow(m_lrob) >= 1 && nrow(f_lrob) >= 1) {
    sex_wald_p(m_lrob$pooled_estimate[1], m_lrob$pooled_sd[1],
               f_lrob$pooled_estimate[1], f_lrob$pooled_sd[1])
  } else NA_real_

  # Power check per sex (overall, all studies)
  k_male   <- if (nrow(m_overall)) m_overall$n_studies[1]          else NA_real_
  n_male   <- if (nrow(m_overall)) m_overall$total_participants[1] else NA_real_
  k_female <- if (nrow(f_overall)) f_overall$n_studies[1]          else NA_real_
  n_female <- if (nrow(f_overall)) f_overall$total_participants[1] else NA_real_

  list(
    p_overall = p_overall,
    p_metareg = p_metareg,
    p_lowrob  = p_lowrob,
    k_male    = k_male, n_male   = n_male,
    k_female  = k_female, n_female = n_female
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# QUALITY GATE — applied to each candidate Q before acceptance
# ============================================================================
# Heterogeneity comparison uses Cochran's Q normalised by degrees of freedom
# (Q/df). Under the null hypothesis of no heterogeneity, Q ~ chi-square(df)
# with mean df, so Q/df = 1 means "expected heterogeneity given study count".
# Q/df is k-independent (unlike Q itself), making it suitable for comparing
# analyses with different study counts. We avoid I² because it depends on the
# precision of the included studies (Borenstein et al.).
#
# Returns list with: pass, q_chosen, df_chosen, q_overall, df_overall,
#   q_ratio_chosen (Q/df), q_ratio_overall, q_ratio_rel (chosen/overall),
#   q_pval_chosen, q_pval_overall, rob_high_chosen, rob_high_overall,
#   mr_R2_chosen, warnings.
#
# Gate criteria (any failure → pass = FALSE):
#   * q_ratio_rel ≤ q_ratio_max  (chosen Q/df not >50% worse than overall)
#   * (rob_high_chosen − rob_high_overall) ≤ rob_delta_max
quality_gate <- function(component, branch_id, ma_long,
                         ma_race_long = NULL,
                         meta_reg_long = NULL,
                         data = NULL,
                         thresholds = THRESHOLDS) {

  warnings <- character(0)
  comp_data <- ma_long %>% filter(urine_component == component)

  # Helper: extract Q and df from a subset of rows. df = n_studies − 1.
  q_stats <- function(rows) {
    if (!nrow(rows) || !"Q" %in% names(rows)) {
      return(list(Q = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, ratio = NA_real_))
    }
    Q  <- rows$Q
    k  <- if ("n_studies" %in% names(rows)) rows$n_studies else rep(NA_real_, nrow(rows))
    df <- k - 1
    p  <- if ("Q_pval" %in% names(rows)) rows$Q_pval else rep(NA_real_, nrow(rows))
    list(
      Q     = mean(Q,  na.rm = TRUE),
      df    = mean(df, na.rm = TRUE),
      p     = if (length(p)) min(p, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      ratio = if (sum(df > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
                mean(Q[df > 0] / df[df > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
              } else NA_real_
    )
  }

  # ----- Reference (overall pooled) -----
  overall_row <- comp_data %>%
    filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), is_overall_age(age_band),
           quality_filter == "All Studies")
  ov_stats <- q_stats(overall_row)

  # ----- Q stats for chosen analysis (per branch) -----
  ch_rows <- switch(as.character(branch_id),
    "2" = comp_data %>%
            filter(sex_group %in% c("male", "female"),
                   is_overall_age(age_band),
                   quality_filter == "All Studies"),
    "3" = comp_data %>%
            filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), quality_filter == "All Studies",
                   grepl("^[0-9]", age_band),
                   n_studies >= thresholds$k_min,
                   total_participants >= thresholds$n_min),
    "4" = if (is.null(ma_race_long)) tibble::tibble() else
            ma_race_long %>%
              filter(urine_component == component, is_overall_age(age_band),
                     is_all_sexes(sex_group),
                     tolower(as.character(race_group)) != "all",
                     n_studies >= thresholds$k_min,
                     total_participants >= thresholds$n_min),
    "5" = {
      ag <- tryCatch(assay_subgroup_ma(component, data = data),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(ag) || !"assay_category" %in% names(ag)) tibble::tibble() else
        ag %>%
          filter(!is.na(pooled_estimate),
                 !grepl("^unreported", tolower(assay_category)),
                 !grepl("\\(blanket\\)$", tolower(assay_category))) %>%
          rename(n_studies = n_studies)   # already named consistently
    },
    "6" = ,
    "6b" = comp_data %>%
            filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), is_metareg_age(age_band),
                   quality_filter == "All Studies"),
    "7" = comp_data %>%
            filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), is_overall_age(age_band),
                   quality_filter == "Low Risk of Bias Only"),
    overall_row   # branch 8 (default) — same as reference
  )
  ch_stats <- q_stats(ch_rows)

  q_ratio_rel <- if (!is.na(ch_stats$ratio) && !is.na(ov_stats$ratio) &&
                     ov_stats$ratio > 0) {
                   ch_stats$ratio / ov_stats$ratio
                 } else NA_real_

  if (!is.na(q_ratio_rel) && q_ratio_rel > thresholds$q_ratio_max) {
    warnings <- c(warnings,
                  sprintf("Chosen Q/df (%.1f) is %.0f%% of overall Q/df (%.1f) — exceeds limit of %.0f%%",
                          ch_stats$ratio, q_ratio_rel * 100, ov_stats$ratio,
                          thresholds$q_ratio_max * 100))
  }

  # ----- Risk-of-bias profile -----
  rob_high_overall <- NA_real_
  rob_high_chosen  <- NA_real_
  if (exists("overall_bias", envir = parent.frame()) ||
      exists("overall_bias", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    bias_tbl <- tryCatch(get("overall_bias", envir = .GlobalEnv),
                         error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(bias_tbl) && "study_name" %in% names(bias_tbl) &&
        "overall" %in% names(bias_tbl)) {
      bias_lookup <- bias_tbl %>%
        select(study_name, rob_level = overall) %>%
        mutate(rob_level = tolower(as.character(rob_level)))

      pct_high <- function(study_names) {
        if (!length(study_names)) return(NA_real_)
        joined <- tibble::tibble(study_name = study_names) %>%
          left_join(bias_lookup, by = "study_name") %>%
          filter(!is.na(rob_level))
        if (!nrow(joined)) return(NA_real_)
        mean(joined$rob_level == "high", na.rm = TRUE)
      }

      # Need access to study_level_data to count by branch — fall back to
      # using urine_ma2 study names as a proxy if available.
      if (exists("urine_ma2", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
        umd <- get("urine_ma2", envir = .GlobalEnv)
        rob_high_overall <- pct_high(unique(umd$study_name))
        rob_high_chosen  <- rob_high_overall  # default same; could be refined per branch
      }
    }
  }
  delta_rob <- if (!is.na(rob_high_chosen) && !is.na(rob_high_overall)) {
                 rob_high_chosen - rob_high_overall
               } else NA_real_
  if (!is.na(delta_rob) && delta_rob > thresholds$rob_delta_max) {
    warnings <- c(warnings,
                  sprintf("High-RoB study proportion in chosen (%.0f%%) exceeds overall (%.0f%%) by %.0f pp (limit %.0f pp)",
                          rob_high_chosen * 100, rob_high_overall * 100,
                          delta_rob * 100, thresholds$rob_delta_max * 100))
  }

  # ----- Meta-regression R² for the chosen analysis -----
  mr_R2_chosen <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(meta_reg_long) && nrow(meta_reg_long)) {
    target_sex <- switch(as.character(branch_id),
      "2" = c("male", "female"),       # Q2 → check sex-specific MR
      c("all", "main meta-analysis", "main_meta_analysis")
    )
    mr_rows <- meta_reg_long %>%
      filter(urine_component == component,
             tolower(sex_group) %in% target_sex)
    if (nrow(mr_rows) && "R2" %in% names(mr_rows)) {
      mr_R2_chosen <- mean(mr_rows$R2, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  list(
    pass             = length(warnings) == 0,
    q_chosen         = ch_stats$Q,
    df_chosen        = ch_stats$df,
    q_pval_chosen    = ch_stats$p,
    q_ratio_chosen   = ch_stats$ratio,
    q_overall        = ov_stats$Q,
    df_overall       = ov_stats$df,
    q_pval_overall   = ov_stats$p,
    q_ratio_overall  = ov_stats$ratio,
    q_ratio_rel      = q_ratio_rel,
    rob_high_chosen  = rob_high_chosen,
    rob_high_overall = rob_high_overall,
    mr_R2_chosen     = mr_R2_chosen,
    warnings         = warnings
  )
}

# Apply the decision framework to one component (single integrated chain
# Q1 → Q2 sex → Q3 age → Q4 race → Q5 assay → Q6 meta-reg → Q6b small-study → Q7 low-RoB → Q8)
# Each accepted branch passes through `quality_gate()` before being returned.
recommend_analysis <- function(component,
                                ma_long       = all_ma_results,
                                ma_race_long  = NULL,
                                data          = urine_ma2,
                                meta_reg_long = NULL,
                                thresholds    = THRESHOLDS) {

  comp_data <- ma_long %>% filter(urine_component == component)

  # Overall pooled (all sexes, overall age band, all studies)
  overall <- comp_data %>%
    filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), is_overall_age(age_band),
           quality_filter == "All Studies")
  k_total <- if (nrow(overall)) overall$n_studies[1]          else NA_real_
  n_total <- if (nrow(overall)) overall$total_participants[1] else NA_real_

  # Egger's p (for Bridge 4 — Q6b small-study-bias adjustment)
  eggers_p <- if (nrow(overall) && "eggers_p" %in% names(overall)) {
                overall$eggers_p[1]
              } else NA_real_

  # Meta-regression overall (all sexes) — pulls R² from whichever source has it
  mr_overall <- comp_data %>%
    filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), is_metareg_age(age_band),
           quality_filter == "All Studies")

  # Try sources in order: meta_reg_long cache → mr_overall row → NA
  R2 <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(meta_reg_long)) {
    mr_row <- meta_reg_long %>%
      filter(urine_component == component, is_all_sexes(sex_group)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)
    if (nrow(mr_row) && "R2" %in% names(mr_row) && !is.na(mr_row$R2[1])) {
      R2 <- mr_row$R2[1]
    }
  }
  if (is.na(R2) && nrow(mr_overall) && "R2" %in% names(mr_overall)) {
    R2 <- mr_overall$R2[1]
  }

  # Bridge 1 — sex via meta-regression coefficient
  # Look up p-value for women_prop_c in meta_reg_long (if supplied)
  women_prop_p <- if (!is.null(meta_reg_long)) {
                    wp <- meta_reg_long %>%
                      filter(urine_component == component,
                             is_all_sexes(sex_group),
                             grepl("^women_prop", term))
                    if (nrow(wp)) wp$p.value[1] else NA_real_
                  } else NA_real_

  # Low risk-of-bias overall
  lrob <- comp_data %>%
    filter(is_all_sexes(sex_group), is_overall_age(age_band),
           quality_filter == "Low Risk of Bias Only")

  # Sex Wald p across tiers
  sex_info <- sex_wald_across_tiers(component, ma_long)

  # Helper to build the standard return row (now includes quality-gate fields)
  build_row <- function(outcome, branch, reason, gate = NULL,
                        age_p = NA_real_, age_powered = NA_integer_,
                        race_p = NA_real_, race_powered = NA_integer_,
                        assay_p = NA_real_, assay_powered = NA_integer_) {
    if (is.null(gate)) gate <- list(
      q_chosen = NA_real_, df_chosen = NA_real_, q_pval_chosen = NA_real_,
      q_ratio_chosen = NA_real_, q_overall = NA_real_, df_overall = NA_real_,
      q_pval_overall = NA_real_, q_ratio_overall = NA_real_,
      q_ratio_rel = NA_real_,
      rob_high_chosen = NA_real_, rob_high_overall = NA_real_,
      mr_R2_chosen = NA_real_, warnings = character(0)
    )
    tibble::tibble(
      component = component,
      outcome   = outcome,
      branch    = branch,
      reason    = reason,
      k = k_total, n = n_total,
      R2 = R2,
      eggers_p      = eggers_p,
      p_women_prop  = women_prop_p,
      p_sex_overall = sex_info$p_overall,
      p_sex_metareg = sex_info$p_metareg,
      p_sex_lowrob  = sex_info$p_lowrob,
      p_age         = age_p,
      n_powered_age = age_powered,
      p_race        = race_p,
      n_powered_race = race_powered,
      p_assay       = assay_p,
      n_powered_assay = assay_powered,
      # Quality-gate columns (Cochran's Q)
      qc_q_chosen         = gate$q_chosen,
      qc_df_chosen        = gate$df_chosen,
      qc_q_pval_chosen    = gate$q_pval_chosen,
      qc_q_ratio_chosen   = gate$q_ratio_chosen,
      qc_q_overall        = gate$q_overall,
      qc_df_overall       = gate$df_overall,
      qc_q_pval_overall   = gate$q_pval_overall,
      qc_q_ratio_overall  = gate$q_ratio_overall,
      qc_q_ratio_rel      = gate$q_ratio_rel,
      qc_rob_high_chosen  = gate$rob_high_chosen,
      qc_rob_high_overall = gate$rob_high_overall,
      qc_mr_R2_chosen     = gate$mr_R2_chosen,
      qc_warnings         = paste(gate$warnings, collapse = "; ")
    )
  }

  # Helper to run the quality gate for a branch and accept it. The gate is
  # ADVISORY ONLY — it computes Q/df, RoB, and meta-reg R² for the chosen
  # subset and surfaces them in the output via the qc_* columns, but DOES NOT
  # reject the branch. Any quality concerns are recorded in `qc_warnings` so
  # the reader can judge whether the framework's choice is genuinely robust.
  try_branch <- function(branch_id, outcome, branch_label, reason_base,
                         age_p = NA_real_, age_powered = NA_integer_,
                         race_p = NA_real_, race_powered = NA_integer_,
                         assay_p = NA_real_, assay_powered = NA_integer_) {
    gate <- quality_gate(component, branch_id, ma_long,
                         ma_race_long  = ma_race_long,
                         meta_reg_long = meta_reg_long,
                         data          = data,
                         thresholds    = thresholds)
    list(rejected = FALSE,
         row = build_row(outcome = outcome, branch = branch_label,
                         reason  = reason_base, gate = gate,
                         age_p = age_p, age_powered = age_powered,
                         race_p = race_p, race_powered = race_powered,
                         assay_p = assay_p, assay_powered = assay_powered))
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 1 : insufficient data ----
  if (is.na(k_total) || is.na(n_total) ||
      k_total < thresholds$k_min || n_total < thresholds$n_min) {
    return(build_row(
      outcome = "Overall pooled (caveats)",
      branch  = "1 — Insufficient data",
      reason  = sprintf("k = %s, n = %s below thresholds (k_min = %d, n_min = %d)",
                        k_total, n_total, thresholds$k_min, thresholds$n_min)
    ))
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 2 : Sex-stratified (Bridge 1 — refined logic) ------------------
  # Power per sex
  sex_powered <- !is.na(sex_info$k_male) && !is.na(sex_info$k_female) &&
                  !is.na(sex_info$n_male) && !is.na(sex_info$n_female) &&
                  sex_info$k_male   >= thresholds$k_min &&
                  sex_info$k_female >= thresholds$k_min &&
                  sex_info$n_male   >= thresholds$n_min &&
                  sex_info$n_female >= thresholds$n_min

  # Tier-level Wald p-values
  tier_ps <- c(overall = sex_info$p_overall,
               metareg = sex_info$p_metareg,
               lowrob  = sex_info$p_lowrob)
  alpha   <- thresholds$wald_alpha

  # Bridge 1 path (a): meta-regression women_prop coefficient is significant
  women_prop_sig <- !is.na(women_prop_p) && women_prop_p < alpha

  # Bridge 1 path (b): ≥ 2 of 3 tiers significant, AND at least one of those
  # is the overall or meta-regression tier (Low-RoB alone is too underpowered
  # to be sufficient evidence)
  n_tiers_sig <- sum(!is.na(tier_ps) & tier_ps < alpha)
  primary_tiers_sig <-
    (!is.na(tier_ps["overall"]) && tier_ps["overall"] < alpha) ||
    (!is.na(tier_ps["metareg"]) && tier_ps["metareg"] < alpha)
  consensus_sig <- n_tiers_sig >= 2 && primary_tiers_sig

  # Pre-compute Q3/Q4/Q5 summaries (used in reason strings even for later branches)
  age_res   <- age_check(component,   ma_long,      thresholds)
  race_res  <- race_check(component,  ma_race_long, thresholds)
  assay_res <- assay_check(component, data,         thresholds)

  if (sex_powered && (women_prop_sig || consensus_sig)) {
    reason_parts <- c()
    if (women_prop_sig) {
      reason_parts <- c(reason_parts,
                        sprintf("women_prop coef p=%s in main meta-regression",
                                format_p(women_prop_p)))
    }
    if (consensus_sig) {
      reason_parts <- c(reason_parts,
                        sprintf("sex p<%.2f in %d of 3 tiers (overall=%s, MR=%s, LRoB=%s)",
                                alpha, n_tiers_sig,
                                format_p(sex_info$p_overall),
                                format_p(sex_info$p_metareg),
                                format_p(sex_info$p_lowrob)))
    }
    res <- try_branch("2", "Sex-stratified", "2 — Robust sex difference",
                      paste(reason_parts, collapse = "; "))
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
    # Quality gate failed — append warning to reason, continue
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 3 : Age-stratified ----
  if (isTRUE(age_res$significant) && !is.na(age_res$n_powered) &&
      age_res$n_powered >= 2) {
    res <- try_branch("3", "Age-stratified", "3 — Robust age difference",
                      sprintf("Age %s", age_res$evidence),
                      age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                      race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                      assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 4 : Race-stratified ----
  if (isTRUE(race_res$significant) && !is.na(race_res$n_powered) &&
      race_res$n_powered >= 2) {
    res <- try_branch("4", "Race-stratified", "4 — Robust race difference",
                      sprintf("Race %s", race_res$evidence),
                      age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                      race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                      assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 5 : Assay/country-stratified (Bridge 2 — Unreported excluded) ----
  if (isTRUE(assay_res$significant) && !is.na(assay_res$n_powered) &&
      assay_res$n_powered >= 2) {
    res <- try_branch("5", "Assay/country-stratified",
                      "5 — Robust assay/country difference",
                      sprintf("Assay %s", assay_res$evidence),
                      age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                      race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                      assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 6 : Meta-regression (Bridge 3 — k floor + R² ≥ threshold) ----
  if (!is.na(R2) && R2 >= thresholds$R2_min &&
      !is.na(k_total) && k_total >= thresholds$R2_k_min) {
    res <- try_branch("6", "Meta-regression", "6 — Meta-regression effective",
                      sprintf("R² = %.1f%% ≥ %.0f%% with k = %d ≥ %d",
                              R2 * 100, thresholds$R2_min * 100,
                              k_total, thresholds$R2_k_min),
                      age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                      race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                      assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 6b : Meta-regression as small-study-bias adjustment (Bridge 4) ----
  if (!is.na(eggers_p) && eggers_p < thresholds$eggers_alpha &&
      !is.na(k_total) && k_total >= thresholds$R2_k_min) {
    res <- try_branch("6b", "Meta-regression",
                      "6b — Small-study bias adjustment",
                      sprintf("Egger's p = %s < %.2f — meta-regression used to adjust for small-study bias (R² = %s, k = %d)",
                              format_p(eggers_p), thresholds$eggers_alpha,
                              ifelse(is.na(R2), "—", sprintf("%.1f%%", R2 * 100)),
                              k_total),
                      age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                      race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                      assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 6c : All stratum tests negative + meta-reg adds value ----
  # Formalises the narrative reasoning pattern: when sex/age/race/assay tests
  # are all non-significant, the meta-regression with moderators serves as the
  # principled population-distribution estimate — but ONLY if it adds value
  # over the simpler overall pooled estimate. If R² is minimal AND meta-reg
  # ≈ overall pooled, the regression adds nothing and we should defer to the
  # simpler pooled estimate (Occam's razor).
  #
  # Q6c fires if:
  #   (a) meta-regression range is clinically valid (lower 95% > 0)
  #   (b) k ≥ R2_k_min (model not saturated)
  #   (c) EITHER R² ≥ R2_q6c_min (moderators explain ≥ 10% of heterogeneity)
  #       OR     meta-reg pooled estimate differs from overall pooled by ≥ 5%
  #              (point estimate meaningfully different)
  mr_lower_95 <- if (nrow(mr_overall) && "lower_95" %in% names(mr_overall)) {
                   mr_overall$lower_95[1]
                 } else NA_real_
  mr_upper_95 <- if (nrow(mr_overall) && "upper_95" %in% names(mr_overall)) {
                   mr_overall$upper_95[1]
                 } else NA_real_
  mr_estimate <- if (nrow(mr_overall) && "pooled_estimate" %in% names(mr_overall)) {
                   mr_overall$pooled_estimate[1]
                 } else NA_real_
  ov_estimate <- if (nrow(overall) && "pooled_estimate" %in% names(overall)) {
                   overall$pooled_estimate[1]
                 } else NA_real_

  # Relative difference between MR and Overall pooled estimates
  mr_rel_diff <- if (!is.na(mr_estimate) && !is.na(ov_estimate) &&
                     abs(ov_estimate) > 0) {
                   abs(mr_estimate - ov_estimate) / abs(ov_estimate)
                 } else NA_real_

  range_valid       <- !is.na(mr_lower_95) && mr_lower_95 > 0
  k_ok              <- !is.na(k_total)     && k_total    >= thresholds$R2_k_min
  R2_meaningful     <- !is.na(R2)          && R2         >= thresholds$R2_q6c_min
  mr_meaningfully_different <- !is.na(mr_rel_diff) && mr_rel_diff >= thresholds$mr_diff_min
  mr_adds_value     <- R2_meaningful || mr_meaningfully_different

  if (range_valid && k_ok && mr_adds_value) {
    why_added <- if (R2_meaningful && mr_meaningfully_different) {
                   sprintf("R² = %.1f%% ≥ %.0f%% AND meta-reg %.2f vs overall %.2f differs by %.1f%% ≥ %.0f%%",
                           R2 * 100, thresholds$R2_q6c_min * 100,
                           mr_estimate, ov_estimate,
                           mr_rel_diff * 100, thresholds$mr_diff_min * 100)
                 } else if (R2_meaningful) {
                   sprintf("R² = %.1f%% ≥ %.0f%%", R2 * 100, thresholds$R2_q6c_min * 100)
                 } else {
                   sprintf("meta-reg %.2f vs overall %.2f differs by %.1f%% ≥ %.0f%%",
                           mr_estimate, ov_estimate,
                           mr_rel_diff * 100, thresholds$mr_diff_min * 100)
                 }
    res <- try_branch("6c", "Meta-regression",
                      "6c — No stratum effect; meta-reg adds value",
                      sprintf("All stratum tests negative (sex p=%s, age p=%s, race p=%s, assay p=%s); range [%.2f, %.2f] valid (lower 95%% > 0); %s; k = %d.",
                              format_p(women_prop_p),
                              format_p(age_res$p_min),
                              format_p(race_res$p_min),
                              format_p(assay_res$p_min),
                              mr_lower_95, mr_upper_95,
                              why_added,
                              k_total),
                      age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                      race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                      assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
    if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 7 : Low-RoB subset preferred ----
  if (nrow(lrob) >= 1 && nrow(overall) >= 1 &&
      !is.na(lrob$pooled_estimate[1]) && !is.na(overall$pooled_estimate[1])) {

    overall_width <- overall$upper_95[1] - overall$lower_95[1]
    lrob_width    <- lrob$upper_95[1]    - lrob$lower_95[1]
    is_tighter    <- !is.na(overall_width) && !is.na(lrob_width) &&
                     lrob_width < overall_width

    rel_diff <- abs(lrob$pooled_estimate[1] - overall$pooled_estimate[1]) /
                abs(overall$pooled_estimate[1])
    is_consistent <- !is.na(rel_diff) && rel_diff <= thresholds$consistency_pct

    if (is_tighter && is_consistent) {
      res <- try_branch("7", "Low risk-of-bias overall",
                        "7 — Low-RoB subset preferred",
                        sprintf("CI width %.2f vs overall %.2f (tighter); shift %.1f%% ≤ %.0f%%",
                                lrob_width, overall_width,
                                rel_diff * 100, thresholds$consistency_pct * 100),
                        age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
                        race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
                        assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered)
      if (!res$rejected) return(res$row)
    }
  }

  # ---- BRANCH 8 : default fallback (Overall pooled) ----
  # The meta-regression fallback is now handled at Q6c (when stratum tests are
  # negative AND meta-reg range is valid AND k ≥ k floor). By the time we
  # reach Q8, either the meta-regression range is invalid, k is below floor,
  # or Q7 (Low-RoB) didn't fire either. In that case, fall back to the
  # straightforward overall pooled estimate with a heterogeneity caveat.
  default_gate <- quality_gate(component, "8", ma_long,
                               ma_race_long  = ma_race_long,
                               meta_reg_long = meta_reg_long,
                               data          = data,
                               thresholds    = thresholds)

  reason_default <- if (is.na(mr_lower_95)) {
    "Meta-regression unavailable; default to overall pooled with heterogeneity caveat"
  } else if (!is.na(mr_lower_95) && mr_lower_95 <= 0) {
    sprintf("Meta-regression lower 95%% bound = %.2f ≤ 0 (clinically invalid for a non-negative measurement); default to overall pooled",
            mr_lower_95)
  } else if (!is.na(k_total) && k_total < thresholds$R2_k_min) {
    sprintf("Meta-regression range %.2f–%.2f valid but k = %d < %d (model saturated); default to overall pooled",
            mr_lower_95, mr_upper_95, k_total, thresholds$R2_k_min)
  } else {
    "No branch criteria met; default to overall pooled with heterogeneity caveat"
  }

  build_row(
    outcome = "Overall pooled",
    branch  = "8 — Default pooled",
    reason  = reason_default,
    gate    = default_gate,
    age_p = age_res$p_min, age_powered = age_res$n_powered,
    race_p = race_res$p_min, race_powered = race_res$n_powered,
    assay_p = assay_res$p_min, assay_powered = assay_res$n_powered
  )
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("—")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

# ============================================================================
# STAGE 2 — Sensitivity check helpers
# ============================================================================
# Each helper returns list(significant, p_min, evidence) where
#   significant = TRUE / FALSE / NA (NA means insufficient data)
#   p_min       = minimum p-value across pairwise comparisons (NA if none)
#   evidence    = short text summary for the caveat string

# Generic pairwise-Wald scan over a set of (mean, sd) rows
pairwise_wald_min <- function(means, sds, alpha = 0.05) {
  ok <- !is.na(means) & !is.na(sds)
  means <- means[ok]; sds <- sds[ok]
  if (length(means) < 2) return(list(p_min = NA_real_, n_pairs = 0L))
  pairs <- combn(length(means), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  ps <- vapply(pairs, function(idx) {
    sex_wald_p(means[idx[1]], sds[idx[1]], means[idx[2]], sds[idx[2]])
  }, numeric(1))
  list(p_min = if (length(ps)) min(ps, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
       n_pairs = length(ps))
}

# Q3 — Age check: Wald across powered age bands in main analysis (all studies).
# Only pairs in which BOTH bands are powered (k ≥ k_min AND n ≥ n_min) are
# tested — this prevents underpowered age bands from triggering a stratified
# recommendation purely because their unstable pooled estimate happens to
# differ from a powered band.
age_check <- function(component, ma_long,
                      thresholds = THRESHOLDS) {
  alpha <- thresholds$wald_alpha
  comp_data <- ma_long %>%
    filter(urine_component == component,
           is_all_sexes(sex_group),
           quality_filter == "All Studies",
           grepl("^[0-9]", age_band))   # numeric age-band rows only

  if (nrow(comp_data) < 2) {
    return(list(significant = NA, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = 0L,
                evidence = "<2 age bands available"))
  }

  n_total_bands <- nrow(comp_data)
  powered_data  <- comp_data %>%
    filter(n_studies          >= thresholds$k_min,
           total_participants >= thresholds$n_min)
  n_powered <- nrow(powered_data)

  if (n_powered < 2) {
    return(list(significant = FALSE, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = n_powered,
                evidence = sprintf("<2 powered age bands (%d/%d powered) — cannot test",
                                   n_powered, n_total_bands)))
  }

  res <- pairwise_wald_min(powered_data$pooled_estimate,
                           powered_data$pooled_sd, alpha)
  list(
    significant = !is.na(res$p_min) && res$p_min < alpha,
    p_min       = res$p_min,
    n_powered   = n_powered,
    evidence    = sprintf("min Wald p = %s across %d powered age-band pair(s); %d/%d bands powered",
                          format_p(res$p_min), res$n_pairs,
                          n_powered, n_total_bands)
  )
}

# Q4 — Race check: Wald across powered race groups in 3rd analysis.
# Only pairs in which BOTH groups are powered are tested.
race_check <- function(component, ma_race_long = NULL,
                       thresholds = THRESHOLDS) {
  alpha <- thresholds$wald_alpha
  if (is.null(ma_race_long)) {
    return(list(significant = NA, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = 0L,
                evidence = "No race-stratified data supplied"))
  }
  comp_data <- ma_race_long %>%
    filter(urine_component == component,
           is_overall_age(age_band),
           is_all_sexes(sex_group),
           tolower(as.character(race_group)) != "all")

  if (nrow(comp_data) < 2) {
    return(list(significant = NA, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = 0L,
                evidence = "<2 race groups with data"))
  }

  n_total_groups <- nrow(comp_data)
  powered_data   <- comp_data %>%
    filter(n_studies          >= thresholds$k_min,
           total_participants >= thresholds$n_min)
  n_powered <- nrow(powered_data)

  if (n_powered < 2) {
    return(list(significant = FALSE, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = n_powered,
                evidence = sprintf("<2 powered race groups (%d/%d powered) — cannot test",
                                   n_powered, n_total_groups)))
  }

  res <- pairwise_wald_min(powered_data$pooled_estimate,
                           powered_data$pooled_sd, alpha)
  list(
    significant = !is.na(res$p_min) && res$p_min < alpha,
    p_min       = res$p_min,
    n_powered   = n_powered,
    evidence    = sprintf("min Wald p = %s across %d powered race pair(s); %d/%d groups powered",
                          format_p(res$p_min), res$n_pairs,
                          n_powered, n_total_groups)
  )
}

# Q5 — Assay/country check (Bridge 2: drop "Unreported" anchor + magnitude floor)
#
# Refinements vs naive pairwise Wald:
#   1. Drop the "Unreported" category before pairwise comparisons. ~95/146
#      studies fall into this bucket because the source text was unparseable;
#      comparisons against it conflate era/country/population with assay.
#   2. Require k ≥ 3 within each named category (already enforced by
#      assay_subgroup_ma).
#   3. Require the relative shift between any pair to exceed
#      `consistency_pct` (default 20%). A pair that is statistically
#      significant but clinically negligible should not trigger
#      assay-stratification.
assay_check <- function(component, data = urine_ma2,
                        thresholds = THRESHOLDS) {
  alpha     <- thresholds$wald_alpha
  min_shift <- thresholds$consistency_pct  # require |Δ| / mean > consistency_pct

  result <- tryCatch(assay_subgroup_ma(component, data = data),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(result) || !"assay_category" %in% names(result)) {
    return(list(significant = NA, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = 0L,
                evidence = "Assay subgroup analysis unavailable"))
  }

  # Drop "Unreported" and any non-named category, keep only powered ones
  named <- result %>%
    filter(!is.na(pooled_estimate),
           !grepl("^unreported", tolower(assay_category)),
           !grepl("\\(blanket\\)$", tolower(assay_category)))

  if (nrow(named) < 2) {
    return(list(significant = NA, p_min = NA_real_, n_powered = nrow(named),
                evidence = sprintf("<2 named, powered assay categories (%d)",
                                   nrow(named))))
  }

  # SE from CI half-width
  named <- named %>% mutate(se = (upper_95 - lower_95) / (2 * 1.96))

  pairs <- combn(nrow(named), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  pair_results <- purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(idx) {
    a <- named[idx[1], ]; b <- named[idx[2], ]
    p <- sex_wald_p(a$pooled_estimate, a$se, b$pooled_estimate, b$se)
    rel_shift <- abs(a$pooled_estimate - b$pooled_estimate) /
                  ((abs(a$pooled_estimate) + abs(b$pooled_estimate)) / 2)
    tibble::tibble(p = p, rel_shift = rel_shift)
  })

  # A pair counts as "significant" only if BOTH p < alpha AND |shift| ≥ min_shift
  significant_pairs <- pair_results %>%
    filter(!is.na(p), p < alpha, !is.na(rel_shift), rel_shift >= min_shift)

  is_sig <- nrow(significant_pairs) >= 1
  p_min  <- if (nrow(pair_results)) min(pair_results$p, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  shift_at_min_p <- if (nrow(pair_results)) {
    pair_results$rel_shift[which.min(pair_results$p)]
  } else NA_real_

  list(
    significant = is_sig,
    p_min       = p_min,
    n_powered   = nrow(named),
    evidence    = sprintf("min Wald p = %s (rel shift %.1f%%) across %d named-category pair(s); %d/%d significant after %.0f%% shift filter",
                          format_p(p_min),
                          ifelse(is.na(shift_at_min_p), 0, shift_at_min_p * 100),
                          nrow(pair_results), nrow(significant_pairs),
                          nrow(pair_results), min_shift * 100)
  )
}

# Backwards-compatible aliases (older code may still call these names)
age_sensitivity_check   <- age_check
race_sensitivity_check  <- race_check
assay_sensitivity_check <- assay_check
```

## Applied Recommendations per Component

The data-driven recommendations table is rendered in **Finalised Results →
Recommendations Summary** later in the document, once the per-component
meta-analysis objects (`*_ma_2nd_analysis` and `*_ma_3rd_analysis`) have been
built. Each per-component sub-section in Finalised Results also displays a
component-specific "Framework Recommendation" callout immediately under its
heading.

```{r analysis_components_setup}
# Component vector used by the framework loop (matches the *_ma_2nd_analysis names)
analysis_components <- c("volume", "ph", "calcium", "oxalate", "urate",
                         "citrate", "creat", "phosphate", "sodium",
                         "potassium", "magnesium", "ammonium", "chloride",
                         "sulphate", "urea")
```

# Functions {.tabset .tabset-pills}
## Main MA Helper Function
```{r}
urine_components = c("volume",
                     "ph",
                     "creat",
                     "calcium",
                     "oxalate",
                     "urate",
                     "citrate",
                     "phosphate",
                     "sodium",
                     "potassium",
                     "magnesium",
                     "ammonium",
                     "chloride",
                     "sulphate",
                     "urea")

age_bands <- levels(urine_ma2$age_band)

main_ma <- function(urine_component, 
                    data = urine_ma2) {
  
  
  # --- 1. Identify mean and SD columns -----------
  mean_colname <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_mean",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_mean_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  sd_colname <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_sd",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_sd_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )

  urine_component_for_title <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "Volume (L/24h)",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "pH",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "Creatinine (mmol/24h)",
    TRUE ~ paste0(str_to_title(urine_component), " (mmol/24h)")
  )

  # --- 2. Prepare data -----------
  data1 <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(study_name, total_n,
                  mean_col = all_of(mean_colname),
                  sd_col = all_of(sd_colname),
                  study_type) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(mean_col, sd_col) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mean_col)

  # Capture raw study-level means BEFORE any transformation, for descriptive stats
  study_means_raw <- data1$mean_col
  study_sds_raw   <- data1$sd_col
  study_n_raw     <- data1$total_n
  study_min_raw   <- if (length(study_means_raw)) min(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  study_max_raw   <- if (length(study_means_raw)) max(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  # Unweighted descriptive mean/SD across study-level means
  study_avg_raw   <- if (length(study_means_raw)) mean(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  study_sd_raw    <- if (length(study_means_raw) > 1) stats::sd(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

  # Convert volume to log-normal
  if (urine_component == "volume") {
    data1 <- data1 %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        mean_raw = mean_col,
        sd_raw = sd_col,
        mean_col = log(mean_raw^2 / sqrt(sd_raw^2 + mean_raw^2)),
        sd_col = sqrt(log(1 + (sd_raw^2 / mean_raw^2)))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-mean_raw, -sd_raw)
  }

  # Run meta-analysis
  ma_result <- metamean(
    n = data1$total_n,
    mean = data1$mean_col,
    sd   = data1$sd_col,
    studlab = data1$study_name
  )
  
  # Extract pooled results
  k <- ma_result$k

  if (k == 1) {
    model_utilised <- "Single study"
    pooled_estimate <- ma_result$TE
    pooled_sd <- ma_result$seTE * sqrt(sum(data1$total_n))
    I2_value <- NA
    Q_value <- NA
    Q_pval <- NA
  } else {
    model_utilised <- if (ma_result$pval.Q < 0.05) "Random" else "Fixed"
    pooled_estimate <- if (ma_result$pval.Q < 0.05) ma_result$TE.random else ma_result$TE.common
    pooled_sd <- if (ma_result$pval.Q < 0.05) ma_result$tau else ma_result$seTE.common * sqrt(sum(data1$total_n))
    I2_value <- ma_result$I2
    Q_value <- ma_result$Q
    Q_pval <- ma_result$pval.Q
  }

  # Egger's test for funnel plot asymmetry (requires k >= 3)
  eggers_p <- tryCatch({
    if (k >= 3) {
      egger_test <- metabias(ma_result, method.bias = "linreg", k.min = 3)
      egger_test$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

  # Make Study type column
  data1$study_type <- as.factor(data1$study_type)
  study_type <- if (dplyr::n_distinct(data1$study_type, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
  "Mixed"
} else {
  unique(na.omit(data1$study_type))
}

  # Create summary tibble
  summary <- tibble(
    urine_component = urine_component,
    sex_group = "all",
    age_band = "overall",
    total_participants = sum(data1$total_n),
    n_studies = k,
    pooled_estimate = pooled_estimate,
    pooled_sd = pooled_sd,
    I2 = I2_value,
    Q = Q_value,
    Q_pval = Q_pval,
    eggers_p = eggers_p,
    model_utilised = model_utilised,
    study_type = study_type,
    # Descriptive statistics across study-level means (raw, pre-transformation)
    study_mean_min = study_min_raw,
    study_mean_max = study_max_raw,
    study_mean_avg = study_avg_raw,
    study_mean_sd  = study_sd_raw
  )

  # Back-transform volume results if needed (and convert descriptive stats from mL to L)
  if (urine_component == "volume") {
    summary <- summary %>%
      mutate(
        lower_95 = exp(pooled_estimate - 1.96 * pooled_sd) / 1000,
        upper_95 = exp(pooled_estimate + 1.96 * pooled_sd) / 1000,
        pooled_estimate = exp(pooled_estimate) / 1000,
        study_mean_min = study_mean_min / 1000,
        study_mean_max = study_mean_max / 1000,
        study_mean_avg = study_mean_avg / 1000,
        study_mean_sd  = study_mean_sd  / 1000
      )
  } else {
    summary <- summary %>%
      mutate(
        lower_95 = pooled_estimate - 1.96 * pooled_sd,
        upper_95 = pooled_estimate + 1.96 * pooled_sd
      )
  }

  return(summary)
}
```

## Single MA Helper function
```{r}
run_single_ma <- function(data1, urine_component, sex, age) {

  # Capture raw study-level means BEFORE any transformation, for descriptive stats
  study_means_raw <- data1$mean_col
  study_min_raw   <- if (length(study_means_raw)) min(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  study_max_raw   <- if (length(study_means_raw)) max(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  study_avg_raw   <- if (length(study_means_raw)) mean(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  study_sd_raw    <- if (length(study_means_raw) > 1) stats::sd(study_means_raw, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

  # Volume → convert to log-normal parameters
  if (urine_component == "volume") {
    data1 <- data1 %>%
      mutate(
        mean_raw = mean_col,
        sd_raw   = sd_col,
        mean_col = log(mean_raw^2 / sqrt(sd_raw^2 + mean_raw^2)),
        sd_col   = sqrt(log(1 + (sd_raw^2 / mean_raw^2)))
      ) %>%
      select(-mean_raw, -sd_raw)
  }

  # Run meta-analysis
  ma_result <- metamean(
    n = data1$total_n,
    mean = data1$mean_col,
    sd   = data1$sd_col,
    studlab = data1$study_name
  )
  
  # Extract pooled results
  k <- ma_result$k

  if (k == 1) {
    model_utilised <- "Single study"
    pooled_estimate <- ma_result$TE
    pooled_sd <- ma_result$seTE * sqrt(sum(data1$total_n))
    I2_value <- NA
    Q_value <- NA
    Q_pval <- NA
  } else {
    model_utilised <- if (ma_result$pval.Q < 0.05) "Random" else "Fixed"
    pooled_estimate <- if (ma_result$pval.Q < 0.05) ma_result$TE.random else ma_result$TE.common
    pooled_sd <- if (ma_result$pval.Q < 0.05) ma_result$tau else ma_result$seTE.common * sqrt(sum(data1$total_n))
    I2_value <- ma_result$I2
    Q_value <- ma_result$Q
    Q_pval <- ma_result$pval.Q
  }

  # Egger's test for funnel plot asymmetry (requires k >= 3)
  eggers_p <- tryCatch({
    if (k >= 3) {
      egger_test <- metabias(ma_result, method.bias = "linreg", k.min = 3)
      egger_test$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

  # Make Study type column
  data1$study_type <- as.factor(data1$study_type)
  study_type <- if (dplyr::n_distinct(data1$study_type, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
  "Mixed"
} else {
  unique(na.omit(data1$study_type))
}

  # Create summary tibble
  summary <- tibble(
    urine_component = urine_component,
    sex_group = sex,
    age_band = age,
    total_participants = sum(data1$total_n),
    n_studies = k,
    pooled_estimate = pooled_estimate,
    pooled_sd = pooled_sd,
    I2 = I2_value,
    Q = Q_value,
    Q_pval = Q_pval,
    eggers_p = eggers_p,
    model_utilised = model_utilised,
    study_type = study_type,
    # Descriptive statistics across study-level means (raw, pre-transformation)
    study_mean_min = study_min_raw,
    study_mean_max = study_max_raw,
    study_mean_avg = study_avg_raw,
    study_mean_sd  = study_sd_raw
  )

  # Back-transform volume results if needed (and convert descriptive stats from mL to L)
  if (urine_component == "volume") {
    summary <- summary %>%
      mutate(
        lower_95 = exp(pooled_estimate - 1.96 * pooled_sd) / 1000,
        upper_95 = exp(pooled_estimate + 1.96 * pooled_sd) / 1000,
        pooled_estimate = exp(pooled_estimate) / 1000,
        study_mean_min = study_mean_min / 1000,
        study_mean_max = study_mean_max / 1000,
        study_mean_avg = study_mean_avg / 1000,
        study_mean_sd  = study_mean_sd  / 1000
      )
  } else {
    summary <- summary %>%
      mutate(
        lower_95 = pooled_estimate - 1.96 * pooled_sd,
        upper_95 = pooled_estimate + 1.96 * pooled_sd
      )
  }

  return(summary)
}
