## Meta-Regression function
```{r}
urine_ma2_for_meta_reg <- urine_ma2_for_meta_reg <- urine_ma2 %>%
  left_join(overall_bias,
            by = "study_name")

# Global cache for full meta-regression coefficient tables — populated by
# meta_regression() during each call. Keyed by "<component>__<sex_group>".
# Used by `format_meta_reg_plain()` to render plain-language interpretations.
meta_reg_full_results <- list()

# Helper to render the full coefficients of a meta-regression as a plain-language
# table. Continuous moderators are scaled to interpretable units:
#   - women_prop_c   -> "per 10% increase in proportion female"
#   - mean_age_c     -> "per decade of mean age"
#   - total_n_c      -> "per 1000 additional participants"
# Categorical moderators (age_band, overall RoB) are left as-is.
format_meta_reg_plain <- function(urine_component, sex_group = "all") {
  key <- paste(urine_component, sex_group, sep = "__")
  if (!key %in% names(meta_reg_full_results)) {
    return(gt::gt(tibble::tibble(Message = paste("No meta-regression result for",
                                                  urine_component, "/", sex_group))))
  }
  tbl <- meta_reg_full_results[[key]]

  fmt_p <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p)      ~ "—",
    p < 0.001     ~ "<0.001",
    p < 0.01      ~ "<0.01",
    p < 0.05      ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
    TRUE          ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )

  tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `Effect (95% CI)` = ifelse(
        is.na(scaled_estimate), "—",
        sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", scaled_estimate, scaled_lower, scaled_upper)
      ),
      `P-value` = fmt_p(p.value)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Moderator` = plain_label,
                  `Direction & magnitude` = plain_text,
                  `Effect (95% CI)`,
                  `P-value`) %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::tab_header(
      title = gt::md(sprintf("**Meta-regression — %s (%s)**",
                              stringr::str_to_title(urine_component),
                              sex_group)),
      subtitle = gt::md("Continuous moderators rescaled for plain-language interpretation.")
    ) %>%
    gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Moderator) %>%
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 11, data_row.padding = gt::px(4))
}

meta_regression <- function(data_subset = "none",
                            data = urine_ma2_for_meta_reg,
                            urine_component = "volume") {
  
  # --- 1. Determine correct column names ------------------------------------
  mean_colname <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "ph_mean",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "creatinine_mean_mmol_24h",
    TRUE ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  
  sd_colname <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "ph_sd",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "creatinine_sd_mmol_24h",
    TRUE ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )
  
  sex_group_name <- case_when(
    data_subset == "none" ~ "main meta-analysis",
    data_subset == "male" ~ "male",
    data_subset == "female" ~ "female",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # --- 1b. Add per-component assay/country category --------------------------
  # study_assay_lookup is loaded in the Setup chunk. assay_cat is component-
  # specific, so we join only the rows for this component.
  if (exists("study_assay_lookup") && !is.null(study_assay_lookup)) {
    .comp_key <- if (urine_component == "creat") "creatinine" else urine_component
    .assay_join <- study_assay_lookup %>%
      dplyr::filter(component == .comp_key) %>%
      dplyr::select(study_name, assay_cat)
    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::left_join(.assay_join, by = "study_name") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(assay_cat = ifelse(is.na(assay_cat) | assay_cat == "",
                                       "Unreported", assay_cat))
  } else {
    data$assay_cat <- "Unreported"
  }

  # --- 2. Build dataset -------------------------------------------------------
  if (data_subset == "none") {
    data1 <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(
        study_name, age_band, total_n, male_female, female_n, race,
        restricted_diet, mean = dplyr::all_of(mean_colname),
        sd   = dplyr::all_of(sd_colname), study_type,
        overall, assay_cat
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        women_prop = dplyr::case_when(
          male_female == "female" ~ female_n / total_n,
          male_female == "male" ~ 0,
          male_female == "mixed" & !is.na(female_n) ~ female_n / total_n,
          male_female == "mixed" & is.na(female_n) ~ 0.5,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        women_prop_c = women_prop - mean(women_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_n_c = total_n - mean(total_n, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na(mean, sd, women_prop_c, overall)
  } else {
    data1 <- data %>%
      dplyr::filter(male_female == data_subset) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        study_name, age_band, total_n, male_female, female_n, race,
        restricted_diet, mean = dplyr::all_of(mean_colname),
        sd   = dplyr::all_of(sd_colname), study_type,
        overall, assay_cat
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        women_prop = dplyr::case_when(
          data_subset == "female" ~ 1,
          data_subset == "male" ~ 0,
          male_female == "mixed" & !is.na(female_n) ~ female_n / total_n,
          male_female == "mixed" & is.na(female_n) ~ 0.5,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        women_prop_c = women_prop - mean(women_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_n_c = total_n - mean(total_n, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na(mean, sd, women_prop_c, overall)
  }
  
  # --- 3. Meta-analysis -------------------------------------------------------
  if (urine_component == "volume"){
    data1 <- data1 %>%
      mutate(
        mean_raw = mean,
        sd_raw = sd,
        mean = log(mean_raw^2 / sqrt(sd_raw^2 + mean_raw^2)),
        sd = sqrt(log(1 + (sd_raw^2 / mean_raw^2)))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-mean_raw, -sd_raw)
    
  ma_result <- metamean(
    n = data1$total_n,
    mean = data1$mean,
    sd = data1$sd,
    studlab = data1$study_name,
    data = data1,
    sm = "MRAW",
    method.tau = "REML",
    method.random.ci = "HK"
  )}
  else {
    ma_result <- metamean(
    n = data1$total_n,
    mean = data1$mean,
    sd = data1$sd,
    studlab = data1$study_name,
    data = data1,
    sm = "MRAW",
    method.tau = "REML",
    method.random.ci = "HK"
  )
  }
  
  k <- ma_result$k
  n_total <- sum(data1$total_n)

  # Egger's test for funnel plot asymmetry (requires k >= 3)
  eggers_p <- tryCatch({
    if (k >= 3) {
      egger_test <- metabias(ma_result, method.bias = "linreg", k.min = 3)
      egger_test$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

  # Include assay_cat only if there are ≥ 2 categories with k ≥ 3 each
  assay_levels <- data1 %>%
    dplyr::count(assay_cat) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n >= 3, !is.na(assay_cat))
  use_assay <- nrow(assay_levels) >= 2
  predictors <- c("women_prop_c", "age_band", "race", "overall", "total_n_c")
  if (use_assay) predictors <- c(predictors, "assay_cat")
  p <- length(predictors)
  
  # Make Study type column
  data1$study_type <- as.factor(data1$study_type)
  study_type <- if (dplyr::n_distinct(data1$study_type, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
  "Mixed"
} else {
  unique(na.omit(data1$study_type))
}
  
  # --- 4. Format output helper ------------------------------------------------
  format_output <- function(tbl, model_type) {
    tbl %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        term = term,
        type = gsub("_c$", "", predictor %||% term),
        estimate = estimate,
        std.error = std.error,
        statistic = statistic,
        p.value = p.value,
        model_type = model_type,
        k = k,
        n = n_total
      )
  }
  
  # --- 5. Multivariable model if feasible ------------------------------------
  if (k > (p + 1)) {
    model <- metareg(
      ma_result,
      formula = as.formula(paste("~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))),
      intercept = TRUE,
      method.tau = "REML"
    )
    
    tbl <- broom::tidy(model)
    tbl$predictor <- tbl$term

    # Save full coefficient table with plain-language interpretation
    full_tbl <- tbl %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Scale factor: per-unit -> per "natural" unit
        scale_mult = dplyr::case_when(
          term == "women_prop_c"               ~ 0.10,    # per 10% female
          term == "mean_age_c"                  ~ 10.00,   # per decade
          term == "total_n_c"                   ~ 1000.00, # per 1000 participants
          TRUE                                  ~ 1.00
        ),
        plain_label = dplyr::case_when(
          term == "intercept"                   ~ "Intercept (reference)",
          term == "women_prop_c"                ~ "% female",
          term == "mean_age_c"                  ~ "Mean age",
          term == "total_n_c"                   ~ "Sample size",
          grepl("^age_band", term)              ~ paste0("Age band: ", sub("^age_band", "", term)),
          grepl("^overall", term)               ~ paste0("RoB: ", sub("^overall", "", term)),
          grepl("^race", term)                  ~ paste0("Race: ", sub("^race", "", term)),
          grepl("^assay_cat", term)             ~ paste0("Assay: ", sub("^assay_cat", "", term)),
          TRUE                                   ~ term
        ),
        plain_text = dplyr::case_when(
          term == "women_prop_c"                ~ "Change per 10% increase in proportion female",
          term == "mean_age_c"                  ~ "Change per decade increase in mean age",
          term == "total_n_c"                   ~ "Change per 1000 additional participants",
          term == "intercept"                   ~ "Pooled estimate at reference values",
          grepl("^assay_cat", term)             ~ "Difference vs reference assay/country category",
          TRUE                                   ~ "Difference vs reference category"
        ),
        scaled_estimate = estimate  * scale_mult,
        scaled_se       = std.error * scale_mult,
        scaled_lower    = scaled_estimate - 1.96 * scaled_se,
        scaled_upper    = scaled_estimate + 1.96 * scaled_se,
        # R² captured here so the cache can serve recommend_analysis() Bridge 3
        R2 = if (!is.null(model$R2)) model$R2 / 100 else NA_real_,
        I2 = if (!is.null(model$I2)) model$I2 / 100 else NA_real_
      )
    meta_reg_full_results[[paste(urine_component, sex_group_name, sep = "__")]] <<- full_tbl

    if (urine_component == "volume") {
      tbl1 <- tbl %>%
        filter(term == "intercept") %>%  
        mutate(
          urine_component = urine_component,
          sex_group = sex_group_name,
          age_band = "Meta-Regression",
          n_studies = k,
          total_participants = sum(ma_result$n),
          I2 = model$I2 / 100,
          R2 = if (!is.null(model$R2)) model$R2 / 100 else NA_real_,
          Q = model$QE,
          Q_pval = model$QEp,
          model_utilised = "Multivariable",
          pooled_estimate = estimate,
          pooled_sd = case_when(
            model$tau2 > 0 ~ sqrt(model$tau2),
            TRUE ~ sqrt(mean(data1$sd^2) + model$tau2)),
          lower_95 = exp(pooled_estimate - (1.96 * pooled_sd)) / 1000,
          upper_95 = exp(pooled_estimate + (1.96 * pooled_sd)) / 1000,
          pooled_estimate = exp(estimate) / 1000,
          eggers_p = eggers_p
        ) %>%
        select(urine_component,
               sex_group,
               age_band,
               total_participants,
               n_studies,
               pooled_estimate,
               pooled_sd,
               I2,
               R2,
               Q,
               Q_pval,
               eggers_p,
               model_utilised,
               lower_95,
               upper_95)
    } else {
      tbl1 <- tbl %>%
        filter(term == "intercept") %>%
        mutate(
          urine_component = urine_component,
          sex_group = sex_group_name,
          age_band = "Meta-Regression",
          n_studies = k,
          total_participants = sum(ma_result$n),
          I2 = model$I2 / 100,
          R2 = if (!is.null(model$R2)) model$R2 / 100 else NA_real_,
          Q = model$QE,
          Q_pval = model$QEp,
          model_utilised = "Multivariable",
          pooled_estimate = estimate,
          pooled_sd = case_when(
            model$tau2 > 0 ~ sqrt(model$tau2),
            TRUE ~ sqrt(mean(data1$sd^2) + model$tau2)),
          lower_95 = pooled_estimate - 1.96 * pooled_sd,
          upper_95 = pooled_estimate + 1.96 * pooled_sd,
          study_type = study_type,
          eggers_p = eggers_p
        ) %>%
        select(urine_component,
               sex_group,
               age_band,
               total_participants,
               n_studies,
               pooled_estimate,
               pooled_sd,
               I2,
               R2,
               Q,
               Q_pval,
               eggers_p,
               model_utilised,
               lower_95,
               upper_95,
               study_type)
    }
    
    return(tbl1)
  }
  
  message(
    paste0("Not enough studies for multivariable meta-regression (k = ", 
           k, ", need > ", p + 1, "). Running univariable models instead.")
  )
  
  # --- 6. Helper to count parameters -----------------------------------------
  param_count <- function(var) {
    x <- data1[[var]]
    if (is.numeric(x)) return(2) # intercept + slope
    return(length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])))
  }
  
  # --- 7. Run univariable models ---------------------------------------------
  first_model <- NULL
  
  results <- purrr::map_df(predictors, function(pred) {
    needed <- param_count(pred)
    
    if (needed >= k) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        term = pred,
        type = pred,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        std.error = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        model_type = "univariable_skipped",
        k = k,
        n = n_total
      ))
    }
    
    model <- tryCatch(
      metareg(ma_result, as.formula(paste("~", pred)),
              intercept = TRUE,
              method.tau = "REML"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(model)) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        term = pred,
        type = pred,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        std.error = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        model_type = "univariable_error",
        k = k,
        n = n_total
      ))
    }
    
    # Store first successful model
    if (is.null(first_model)) {
      first_model <<- model
    }
    
    tbl <- broom::tidy(model)
    tbl$predictor <- pred
    format_output(tbl, model_type = "Univariable")
  })
  
  # Check if we have a valid model before proceeding
  if (is.null(first_model)) {
    warning("No successful univariable models were fitted")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Save full coefficient table with plain-language interpretation (univariable path)
  full_tbl <- results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      scale_mult = dplyr::case_when(
        term == "women_prop_c"               ~ 0.10,
        term == "mean_age_c"                  ~ 10.00,
        term == "total_n_c"                   ~ 1000.00,
        TRUE                                  ~ 1.00
      ),
      plain_label = dplyr::case_when(
        term == "intercept"                   ~ "Intercept (reference)",
        term == "women_prop_c"                ~ "% female",
        term == "mean_age_c"                  ~ "Mean age",
        term == "total_n_c"                   ~ "Sample size",
        grepl("^age_band", term)              ~ paste0("Age band: ", sub("^age_band", "", term)),
        grepl("^overall", term)               ~ paste0("RoB: ", sub("^overall", "", term)),
        grepl("^race", term)                  ~ paste0("Race: ", sub("^race", "", term)),
        grepl("^assay_cat", term)             ~ paste0("Assay: ", sub("^assay_cat", "", term)),
        TRUE                                   ~ term
      ),
      plain_text = dplyr::case_when(
        term == "women_prop_c"                ~ "Change per 10% increase in proportion female",
        term == "mean_age_c"                  ~ "Change per decade increase in mean age",
        term == "total_n_c"                   ~ "Change per 1000 additional participants",
        term == "intercept"                   ~ "Pooled estimate at reference values",
        grepl("^assay_cat", term)             ~ "Difference vs reference assay/country category",
        TRUE                                   ~ "Difference vs reference category"
      ),
      scaled_estimate = estimate  * scale_mult,
      scaled_se       = std.error * scale_mult,
      scaled_lower    = scaled_estimate - 1.96 * scaled_se,
      scaled_upper    = scaled_estimate + 1.96 * scaled_se,
      # R² captured here so the cache can serve recommend_analysis() Bridge 3
      R2 = if (!is.null(first_model$R2)) first_model$R2 / 100 else NA_real_,
      I2 = if (!is.null(first_model$I2)) first_model$I2 / 100 else NA_real_
    )
  meta_reg_full_results[[paste(urine_component, sex_group_name, sep = "__")]] <<- full_tbl

  if (urine_component == "volume") {
    results <- results %>%
      filter(term == "intercept") %>%  
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      mutate(
        urine_component = urine_component,
        sex_group = sex_group_name,
        age_band = "Meta-Regression",
        total_participants = sum(ma_result$n),
        pooled_estimate = estimate,
        pooled_sd = case_when(
            first_model$tau2 > 0 ~ sqrt(first_model$tau2),
            TRUE ~ sqrt(mean(data1$sd^2) + model$tau2)),
        n_studies = k,
        I2 = first_model$I2 / 100,
        R2 = if (!is.null(first_model$R2)) first_model$R2 / 100 else NA_real_,
        Q = first_model$QE,
        Q_pval = first_model$QEp,
        model_utilised = "Univariable",
        lower_95 = exp(pooled_estimate - (1.96 * pooled_sd)) / 1000,
        upper_95 = exp(pooled_estimate + (1.96 * pooled_sd)) / 1000,
        pooled_estimate = exp(estimate) / 1000,
        study_type = study_type,
        eggers_p = eggers_p
      ) %>%
      select(urine_component,
             sex_group,
             age_band,
             total_participants,
             n_studies,
             pooled_estimate,
             pooled_sd,
             I2,
             R2,
             Q,
             Q_pval,
             eggers_p,
             model_utilised,
             lower_95,
             upper_95,
             study_type)
  } else {
    results <- results %>%
      filter(term == "intercept") %>%
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      mutate(
        urine_component = urine_component,
        sex_group = sex_group_name,
        age_band = "Meta-Regression",
        total_participants = sum(ma_result$n),
        pooled_estimate = estimate,
        pooled_sd = case_when(
            first_model$tau2 > 0 ~ sqrt(first_model$tau2),
            TRUE ~ sqrt(mean(data1$sd^2) + first_model$tau2)),
        n_studies = k,
        I2 = first_model$I2 / 100,
        R2 = if (!is.null(first_model$R2)) first_model$R2 / 100 else NA_real_,
        Q = first_model$QE,
        Q_pval = first_model$QEp,
        model_utilised = "Univariable",
        lower_95 = pooled_estimate - (1.96 * pooled_sd),
        upper_95 = pooled_estimate + (1.96 * pooled_sd),
        study_type = study_type,
        eggers_p = eggers_p
      ) %>%
      select(urine_component,
             sex_group,
             age_band,
             total_participants,
             n_studies,
             pooled_estimate,
             pooled_sd,
             I2,
             R2,
             Q,
             Q_pval,
             eggers_p,
             model_utilised,
             lower_95,
             upper_95,
             study_type)
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```


## Assay subgroup analysis & meta-regression covariate (A5)

```{r assay_subgroup_helpers}
# Run a meta-analysis stratified by assay category for one urine component.
# Returns a tibble: one row per assay category with k, n, pooled estimate, CI,
# I², Q p-value, and Egger's p (where computable). Categories with k < 3 are
# reported separately (to acknowledge low power) but not pooled.
assay_subgroup_ma <- function(urine_component, data = urine_ma2,
                               min_k = 3) {

  # Identify mean/SD column names (same logic as main_ma)
  mean_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_mean",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_mean_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  sd_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_sd",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_sd_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )

  data_assay <- add_assay_column(data, urine_component) %>%
    dplyr::select(study_name, total_n, assay_cat, preservative_used,
                  mean_val = dplyr::all_of(mean_col),
                  sd_val   = dplyr::all_of(sd_col)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(mean_val, sd_val)

  if (nrow(data_assay) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(message = "No data with this component"))
  }

  # Tally categories
  cat_counts <- data_assay %>% dplyr::count(assay_cat, name = "k")

  # Run MA per assay category that has k >= min_k
  ma_per_cat <- purrr::map_dfr(cat_counts$assay_cat, function(cat) {
    sub <- data_assay %>% dplyr::filter(assay_cat == cat)
    k <- nrow(sub)
    if (k < min_k) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        assay_category   = cat,
        n_studies        = k,
        n_participants   = sum(sub$total_n),
        pooled_estimate  = NA_real_,
        lower_95         = NA_real_,
        upper_95         = NA_real_,
        I2               = NA_real_,
        Q_pval           = NA_real_,
        eggers_p         = NA_real_,
        note             = sprintf("k = %d < min_k = %d (skipped)", k, min_k)
      ))
    }

    ma <- tryCatch(
      meta::metamean(n = sub$total_n,
                     mean = sub$mean_val,
                     sd   = sub$sd_val,
                     studlab = sub$study_name,
                     method.tau = "REML",
                     sm = "MRAW"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(ma)) {
      return(tibble::tibble(assay_category = cat, n_studies = k,
                             n_participants = sum(sub$total_n),
                             pooled_estimate = NA_real_, lower_95 = NA_real_,
                             upper_95 = NA_real_, I2 = NA_real_,
                             Q_pval = NA_real_, eggers_p = NA_real_,
                             note = "Meta-analysis failed"))
    }

    # Egger's test (k >= 3)
    eggers_p <- tryCatch({
      meta::metabias(ma, method.bias = "linreg", k.min = 3)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    tibble::tibble(
      assay_category  = cat,
      n_studies       = k,
      n_participants  = sum(sub$total_n),
      pooled_estimate = ma$TE.random,
      lower_95        = ma$lower.random,
      upper_95        = ma$upper.random,
      I2              = ma$I2,
      Q_pval          = ma$pval.Q,
      eggers_p        = eggers_p,
      note            = ""
    )
  })

  ma_per_cat %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_studies))
}

# Render the assay subgroup result as a gt table
format_assay_subgroup_gt <- function(result, urine_component) {
  if (!"assay_category" %in% names(result)) {
    return(gt::gt(result))
  }

  fmt_p <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "—",
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    p < 0.01  ~ "<0.01",
    p < 0.05  ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
    TRUE      ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )

  result %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `95% CI` = ifelse(
        is.na(pooled_estimate),
        "—",
        sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", pooled_estimate, lower_95, upper_95)
      ),
      `I²`           = ifelse(is.na(I2),     "—", sprintf("%.0f%%", I2 * 100)),
      `Q p-value`    = fmt_p(Q_pval),
      `Egger's p`    = fmt_p(eggers_p),
      `Participants` = format(n_participants, big.mark = ",")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Assay category` = assay_category,
                  `Studies, n`     = n_studies,
                  Participants,
                  `95% CI`,
                  `I²`,
                  `Q p-value`,
                  `Egger's p`,
                  Note            = note) %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::tab_header(
      title    = gt::md(sprintf("**Assay subgroup analysis — %s**",
                                stringr::str_to_title(urine_component))),
      subtitle = gt::md("*Per-assay pooled estimates; categories with k < 3 listed but not pooled.*")
    ) %>%
    gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = -`Assay category`) %>%
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 11, data_row.padding = gt::px(4))
}

# Quick helper combining the analysis + display
assay_subgroup_table <- function(urine_component, data = urine_ma2) {
  res <- assay_subgroup_ma(urine_component, data)
  format_assay_subgroup_gt(res, urine_component)
}

# Sensitivity analysis: with vs without preservative-using cohorts
preservative_sensitivity_ma <- function(urine_component, data = urine_ma2) {
  mean_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_mean",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_mean_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  sd_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_sd",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_sd_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )

  data_p <- add_assay_column(data, urine_component) %>%
    dplyr::select(study_name, total_n, preservative_used,
                  mean_val = dplyr::all_of(mean_col),
                  sd_val   = dplyr::all_of(sd_col)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(mean_val, sd_val)

  run_ma <- function(d) {
    if (nrow(d) < 2) return(NULL)
    tryCatch(
      meta::metamean(n = d$total_n, mean = d$mean_val, sd = d$sd_val,
                     studlab = d$study_name, method.tau = "REML", sm = "MRAW"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }

  groups <- list(
    `All studies`            = data_p,
    `Excluding preservative` = data_p %>% dplyr::filter(!preservative_used),
    `Preservative only`      = data_p %>% dplyr::filter(preservative_used)
  )

  purrr::map_dfr(names(groups), function(grp) {
    d  <- groups[[grp]]
    ma <- run_ma(d)
    if (is.null(ma)) {
      return(tibble::tibble(group = grp, n_studies = nrow(d),
                             n_participants = sum(d$total_n),
                             pooled_estimate = NA_real_,
                             lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_))
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      group           = grp,
      n_studies       = ma$k,
      n_participants  = sum(d$total_n),
      pooled_estimate = ma$TE.random,
      lower_95        = ma$lower.random,
      upper_95        = ma$upper.random
    )
  })
}

# Sensitivity analysis: compare the all-studies meta-analysis to a subset
# restricted to studies that report 24h urine creatinine. 24h creatinine
# is conventionally used to verify collection completeness — studies that
# don't report it cannot reliably confirm that collections were complete,
# and may include incomplete (lower-volume) samples that bias other
# analyte estimates. A material shift between the full and creatinine-
# reporting subsets would therefore flag a possible completeness bias.
#
# Returns a 3-row tibble with All studies / Creatinine reported only /
# Creatinine NOT reported, plus pooled estimate, CI, and n.
creat_completeness_ma <- function(urine_component, data = urine_ma2) {
  if (urine_component == "creat") {
    # By definition, this analysis is only the studies reporting creatinine
    return(tibble::tibble(group = "Not applicable",
                          n_studies = NA_integer_,
                          n_participants = NA_integer_,
                          pooled_estimate = NA_real_,
                          lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_))
  }

  mean_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_mean",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  sd_col <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_sd",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )

  d_all <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(study_name, total_n,
                  mean_val = dplyr::all_of(mean_col),
                  sd_val   = dplyr::all_of(sd_col),
                  creatinine_mean_mmol_24h) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(mean_val, sd_val) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(reports_creat = !is.na(creatinine_mean_mmol_24h))

  run_ma <- function(d) {
    if (nrow(d) < 2) return(NULL)
    tryCatch(
      meta::metamean(n = d$total_n, mean = d$mean_val, sd = d$sd_val,
                     studlab = d$study_name, method.tau = "REML", sm = "MRAW"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }

  groups <- list(
    `All studies`               = d_all,
    `Creatinine reported only`  = d_all %>% dplyr::filter(reports_creat),
    `Creatinine NOT reported`   = d_all %>% dplyr::filter(!reports_creat)
  )

  purrr::map_dfr(names(groups), function(grp) {
    d  <- groups[[grp]]
    ma <- run_ma(d)
    if (is.null(ma)) {
      return(tibble::tibble(group = grp, n_studies = nrow(d),
                             n_participants = sum(d$total_n),
                             pooled_estimate = NA_real_,
                             lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_))
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      group           = grp,
      n_studies       = ma$k,
      n_participants  = sum(d$total_n),
      pooled_estimate = ma$TE.random,
      lower_95        = ma$lower.random,
      upper_95        = ma$upper.random
    )
  })
}

# Render `creat_completeness_ma` output as a gt table with a flag if the
# creatinine-reporting subset estimate differs from the all-studies estimate
# by more than `consistency_pct` (default 20%).
creat_completeness_table <- function(urine_component, data = urine_ma2,
                                     thresholds = THRESHOLDS) {
  res <- creat_completeness_ma(urine_component, data = data)

  if (urine_component == "creat" || nrow(res) == 0) {
    return(gt::gt(tibble::tibble(
      Message = "Not applicable to creatinine itself"
    )) %>% gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("**Creatinine-completeness sensitivity**")))
  }

  ref <- res %>% dplyr::filter(group == "All studies")
  ref_est <- if (nrow(ref)) ref$pooled_estimate[1] else NA_real_

  res2 <- res %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `Range (95% CI)` = ifelse(
        is.na(pooled_estimate), "—",
        sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", pooled_estimate, lower_95, upper_95)
      ),
      `Δ vs all-studies (%)` = dplyr::case_when(
        group == "All studies"        ~ "—",
        is.na(pooled_estimate) | is.na(ref_est) | ref_est == 0 ~ "—",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%+.1f%%", 100 * (pooled_estimate - ref_est) / ref_est)
      ),
      Flag = dplyr::case_when(
        group == "All studies" ~ "—",
        is.na(pooled_estimate) | is.na(ref_est) | ref_est == 0 ~ "—",
        abs(pooled_estimate - ref_est) / abs(ref_est) > thresholds$consistency_pct ~
          sprintf("⚠ shift > %.0f%%", thresholds$consistency_pct * 100),
        TRUE ~ "OK"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Subset           = group,
      `Studies, n`     = n_studies,
      Participants     = format(n_participants, big.mark = ","),
      `Range (95% CI)` = `Range (95% CI)`,
      `Δ vs all-studies (%)` = `Δ vs all-studies (%)`,
      Flag             = Flag
    )

  res2 %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::tab_header(
      title    = gt::md(sprintf("**Creatinine-completeness sensitivity — %s**",
                                stringr::str_to_title(urine_component))),
      subtitle = gt::md("*Compares the all-studies pooled estimate against subsets defined by whether the study reported 24h urine creatinine. Studies that do not report creatinine cannot verify collection completeness; a substantial shift here flags possible bias from incomplete collections.*")
    ) %>%
    gt::data_color(
      columns = Flag,
      fn = function(x) {
        dplyr::case_when(
          grepl("^⚠", x) ~ "#fff3cd",
          x == "OK"           ~ "#d4edda",
          TRUE                 ~ "#f0f0f0"
        )
      }
    ) %>%
    gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Subset) %>%
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 11, data_row.padding = gt::px(4))
}
```


## Reduce I² in Main MA by removing outlying studies
```{r}
main_ma_reduce_I2 <- function(urine_component, data = urine_ma2) {

  # --- 1. Identify mean and SD columns -----------
  mean_colname <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_mean",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_mean_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  sd_colname <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph"     ~ "ph_sd",
    urine_component == "creat"  ~ "creatinine_sd_mmol_24h",
    TRUE                        ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )

  urine_component_for_title <- dplyr::case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "Volume (L/24h)",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "pH",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "Creatinine (mmol/24h)",
    TRUE ~ paste0(str_to_title(urine_component), " (mmol/24h)")
  )

  # --- 2. Prepare data -----------
  data_iter <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(study_name, total_n,
                  mean_col = all_of(mean_colname),
                  sd_col = all_of(sd_colname), study_type) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(mean_col, sd_col) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mean_col)

  # Convert volume to log-normal
  if (urine_component == "volume") {
    data_iter <- data_iter %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        mean_raw = mean_col,
        sd_raw = sd_col,
        mean_col = log(mean_raw^2 / sqrt(sd_raw^2 + mean_raw^2)),
        sd_col = sqrt(log(1 + (sd_raw^2 / mean_raw^2)))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-mean_raw, -sd_raw)
  }
  
  # Make Study type column
  data_iter$study_type <- as.factor(data_iter$study_type)
  study_type <- if (dplyr::n_distinct(data_iter$study_type, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
  "Mixed"
} else {
  unique(na.omit(data_iter$study_type))
}

  # --- 3. Identify clusters -----------
  clusters <- list()
  cluster_data_list <- list()
  cluster_id <- 1

  while(nrow(data_iter) >= 3) {
    cluster_data <- data_iter
    repeat {
      if(nrow(cluster_data) < 3) break
      ma_result <- tryCatch(
        metamean(n = cluster_data$total_n,
                 mean = cluster_data$mean_col,
                 sd = cluster_data$sd_col,
                 studlab = cluster_data$study_name),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if(is.null(ma_result)) break
      if(ma_result$I2 < 0.5) break
      cluster_data <- cluster_data %>% dplyr::slice(-c(1, nrow(.)))
    }
    if(nrow(cluster_data) < 3) break

    ma_test <- tryCatch(
      metamean(n = cluster_data$total_n,
               mean = cluster_data$mean_col,
               sd = cluster_data$sd_col,
               studlab = cluster_data$study_name),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if(is.null(ma_test)) {
      data_iter <- data_iter %>% dplyr::slice(-(1:nrow(cluster_data)))
      next
    }

    clusters[[cluster_id]] <- cluster_data
    cluster_data_list[[cluster_id]] <- cluster_data
    cluster_id <- cluster_id + 1
    data_iter <- dplyr::anti_join(data_iter, cluster_data, by = "study_name")
  }

  if(length(clusters) == 0) {
    warning("No clusters with I² < 0.5 identified.")
    return(list(summary = NULL, table = NULL, plot = NULL, cluster_data = NULL))
  }

  # --- 4. Summarize clusters -----------
  cluster_summaries <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(clusters), function(i) {
    d <- clusters[[i]]
    ma <- tryCatch(
      metamean(n = d$total_n,
               mean = d$mean_col,
               sd = d$sd_col,
               studlab = d$study_name),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if(is.null(ma)) return(NULL)

    est <- ifelse(ma$pval.Q < 0.05, ma$TE.random, ma$TE.common)
    sd_val <- ifelse(ma$pval.Q < 0.05, ma$tau, ma$seTE.common * sqrt(sum(d$total_n)))

    if(urine_component == "volume") {
      est_bt <- exp(est)/1000
      lower_95 <- exp(est - 1.96*sd_val)/1000
      upper_95 <- exp(est + 1.96*sd_val)/1000
    } else {
      est_bt <- est
      lower_95 <- est - 1.96*sd_val
      upper_95 <- est + 1.96*sd_val
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      cluster = i,
      n_studies = nrow(d),
      total_participants = sum(d$total_n),
      pooled_estimate = est_bt,
      pooled_sd = sd_val,
      I2 = ma$I2 / 100,
      Q = ma$Q,
      Q_pval = ma$pval.Q,
      Model = "Fixed",
      lower_95 = lower_95,
      upper_95 = upper_95,
      studies_in_cluster = paste(d$study_name, collapse = ", "),
      cluster_data = list(d),
      study_type = study_type
    )
  }) %>% 
    arrange(cluster) %>%
    mutate(cluster_factor = factor(cluster))

  # --- 5. Assign consistent colors -----------
  cluster_colors <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(cluster_summaries$cluster)))

  # --- 6. Create GT table -----------
  table_gt <- cluster_summaries %>%
    mutate(
      range = sprintf("%.2f – %.2f", lower_95, upper_95),
      I2_text = ifelse(is.na(I2), "—", paste0(round(I2*100, 1), "%")),
      Q_text = ifelse(is.na(Q), "—", round(Q, 1)),
      Q_pval_text = ifelse(is.na(Q_pval), "—", signif(Q_pval, 1))
    ) %>%
    select(cluster, range, n_studies, total_participants, I2_text, Q_text, Q_pval_text, Model) %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_label(
      cluster = "Cluster",
      n_studies = "Studies",
      study_type = "Study Type",
      total_participants = "Participants",
      range = "95% Range",
      I2_text = "I²",
      Q_text = "Cochran's Q",
      Q_pval_text = "Q p-value",
      Model = "Model"
    ) %>%
    tab_header(title = md("**MA Results for Clusters with I² < 50%**"),
               subtitle = md(urine_component_for_title)) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
    )

  for(i in seq_along(unique(cluster_summaries$cluster))) {
    table_gt <- table_gt %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = cluster_colors[i]),
        locations = cells_body(
          rows = cluster == unique(cluster_summaries$cluster)[i]
        )
      )
  }

  # --- 7. Forest plot with consistent colors -----------
  forest_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(cluster_summaries, ggplot2::aes(y = cluster_factor)) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(ggplot2::aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95, color = cluster_factor), height = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(x = pooled_estimate, color = cluster_factor), size = 3) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Clusters with I² < 50% for ", urine_component_for_title),
      x = paste0("Estimated 95% CI for ", urine_component_for_title),
      y = "Cluster"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

  # --- 8. Combine with patchwork -----------
  combined_plot <- forest_plot / table_gt

  # --- 9. Return results -----------
  list(
    summary = cluster_summaries,
    table = table_gt,
    plot = combined_plot,
    cluster_data = purrr::map(cluster_summaries$cluster_data, ~ .x)
  )
}


```


## Comparison to Sex subdivisions
```{r}
sex_age_subdivision_ma <- function(urine_component,
                                   data = urine_ma2,
                                   overall_bias = NULL) {
  
  # --- 1. Identify the correct columns -------------------------------
  mean_colname <- case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_mean_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "ph_mean",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "creatinine_mean_mmol_24h",
    TRUE ~ paste0(urine_component, "_mean_mmol_24h")
  )
  
  sd_colname <- case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "volume_sd_m_l",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "ph_sd",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "creatinine_sd_mmol_24h",
    TRUE ~ paste0(urine_component, "_sd_mmol_24h")
  )
  
  urine_component_for_title <- case_when(
    urine_component == "volume" ~ "Volume (L/24h)",
    urine_component == "ph" ~ "pH",
    urine_component == "creat" ~ "Creatinine (mmol/24h)",
    TRUE ~ paste0(str_to_title(urine_component), " (mmol/24h)")
  )
  
  # --- 2. Prepare data with overall_bias for meta-regression --------
  if (!is.null(overall_bias)) {
    data_with_bias <- data %>%
      left_join(overall_bias, by = "study_name")
  } else {
    data_with_bias <- data
  }
  
  # --- 3. Get main meta-analysis result ----------------------------
  # Overall main result (all sexes, all ages, all studies)
  main_overall <- main_ma(urine_component, data = data) %>%
    mutate(sex_group = "main meta-analysis",
           age_band = "Overall",
           rct_status = "All studies")
  
  # Main meta-analysis by age band (all sexes combined, all studies)
  data_main <- data %>%
    select(
      study_name,
      total_n,
      age_band,
      mean_col = all_of(mean_colname),
      sd_col   = all_of(sd_colname),
      study_type
    ) %>%
    drop_na(mean_col, sd_col)
  
  age_bands_main <- data_main %>% 
    filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>% 
    pull(age_band) %>% 
    unique() %>% 
    sort()
  
  main_age_results <- purrr::map_dfr(age_bands_main, function(age) {
    data_age <- data_main %>% 
      filter(age_band == age)
    
    if (nrow(data_age) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    
    result <- run_single_ma(data_age, urine_component, "main meta-analysis", age)
    result %>% mutate(rct_status = "All studies")
  })
  
  # Add meta-regression for main analysis (all studies)
  main_meta_reg_results <- tryCatch({
    result <- meta_regression("none", urine_component = urine_component)
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      result %>% mutate(rct_status = "All studies")
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Meta-regression failed for main analysis: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  
  main_result <- bind_rows(main_overall, main_age_results, main_meta_reg_results)
  
  # --- 3b. RCT-only main analysis ----------------------------
  data_main_rct <- data %>%
    filter(study_type == "RCT") %>%
    select(
      study_name,
      total_n,
      age_band,
      study_type,
      mean_col = all_of(mean_colname),
      sd_col   = all_of(sd_colname)
    ) %>%
    drop_na(mean_col, sd_col)
  
  if (nrow(data_main_rct) > 0) {
    # Overall RCT result
    main_rct_overall <- run_single_ma(data_main_rct, urine_component, "main meta-analysis", "Overall") %>%
      mutate(rct_status = "RCT only")
    
    # RCT by age band
    main_rct_age_results <- purrr::map_dfr(age_bands_main, function(age) {
      data_age <- data_main_rct %>% 
        filter(age_band == age)
      
      if (nrow(data_age) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      result <- run_single_ma(data_age, urine_component, "main meta-analysis", age)
      result %>% mutate(rct_status = "RCT only")
    })
    
    main_rct_result <- bind_rows(main_rct_overall, main_rct_age_results)
  } else {
    main_rct_result <- tibble()
  }
  
  # --- 4. Iterate through sexes and age bands --------------------------------
  sex_age_results <- purrr::map_dfr(c("male", "female"), function(sex) {
    
    # First get overall result for this sex (all age bands, all studies)
    data_sex <- data %>% 
      filter(male_female == sex) %>%
      select(
        study_name,
        total_n,
        age_band,
        mean_col = all_of(mean_colname),
        sd_col   = all_of(sd_colname),
        study_type
      ) %>%
      drop_na(mean_col, sd_col)
    
    if (nrow(data_sex) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    
    # Get overall result for this sex (all studies)
    overall_result <- run_single_ma(data_sex, urine_component, sex, "Overall") %>%
      mutate(rct_status = "All studies")
    
    # Get meta-regression result for this sex (all studies)
    meta_reg_result <- tryCatch({
      result <- meta_regression(data_subset = sex, urine_component = urine_component)
      if (!is.null(result)) {
        result %>% mutate(rct_status = "All studies")
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Meta-regression failed for ", sex, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
    
    # Get unique age bands
    age_bands <- data_sex %>% 
      filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>% 
      pull(age_band) %>% 
      unique() %>% 
      sort()
    
    # Get results for each age band (all studies)
    age_band_results <- purrr::map_dfr(age_bands, function(age) {
      data_age <- data_sex %>% 
        filter(age_band == age)
      
      if (nrow(data_age) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      result <- run_single_ma(data_age, urine_component, sex, age)
      result %>% mutate(rct_status = "All studies")
    })
    
    # --- RCT-only analyses for this sex ---
    data_sex_rct <- data_sex %>%
      filter(study_type == "RCT")
    
    if (nrow(data_sex_rct) > 0) {
      # Overall RCT for this sex
      rct_overall <- run_single_ma(data_sex_rct, urine_component, sex, "Overall") %>%
        mutate(rct_status = "RCT only")
      
      # RCT by age band for this sex
      rct_age_results <- purrr::map_dfr(age_bands, function(age) {
        data_age <- data_sex_rct %>% 
          filter(age_band == age)
        
        if (nrow(data_age) == 0) {
          return(tibble())
        }
        
        result <- run_single_ma(data_age, urine_component, sex, age)
        result %>% mutate(rct_status = "RCT only")
      })
      
      rct_sex_results <- bind_rows(rct_overall, rct_age_results)
    } else {
      rct_sex_results <- tibble()
    }
    
    # Combine overall, age band, meta-regression, and RCT results
    bind_rows(overall_result, age_band_results, meta_reg_result, rct_sex_results)
  })
  
  # --- 5. Combine all results --------------------
  combined_results <- bind_rows(main_result, main_rct_result, sex_age_results) %>%
    mutate(
      sex_group = factor(sex_group,
                        levels = c("main meta-analysis", "male", "female")),
      rct_status = ifelse(is.na(rct_status), "All studies", rct_status)
    ) %>%
    arrange(sex_group, rct_status, age_band)
  
  # --- 6. Create plots and tables for each sex group (All studies) --------------------
  sex_groups <- c("main meta-analysis", "male", "female")
  
  output_list <- purrr::map(sex_groups, function(sex) {
    
    # Filter data for this sex group (All studies only)
    sex_data <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == sex, rct_status == "All studies")
    
    # Create forest plot
    colour <- case_when(
      sex == "main meta-analysis" ~ "springgreen3",
      sex == "male" ~ "skyblue2",
      sex == "female" ~ "indianred1"
    )
    
    plot <- sex_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(pooled_estimate)) %>%
      mutate(age_band = fct_rev(age_band)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(y = age_band)) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95), 
                     height = 0.25, colour = colour) +
      geom_point(aes(x = pooled_estimate), size = 3, colour = colour) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(str_to_title(sex)),
        x = "Estimated 95% CI",
        y = "Age Band"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
      )
    
    list(
      plot = plot,
      data = sex_data
    )
  })
  
  names(output_list) <- sex_groups
  
  # --- 6b. Create RCT-only plots for each sex group --------------------
  rct_output_list <- purrr::map(sex_groups, function(sex) {
    
    # Filter data for this sex group (RCT only)
    sex_rct_data <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == sex, rct_status == "RCT only")
    
    # Only create plot if there's data
    if (nrow(sex_rct_data %>% filter(!is.na(pooled_estimate))) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create forest plot
    colour <- case_when(
      sex == "main meta-analysis" ~ "springgreen3",
      sex == "male" ~ "skyblue2",
      sex == "female" ~ "indianred1"
    )
    
    plot <- sex_rct_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(pooled_estimate)) %>%
      mutate(age_band = fct_rev(age_band)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(y = age_band)) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95), 
                     height = 0.25, colour = colour) +
      geom_point(aes(x = pooled_estimate), size = 3, colour = colour) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(str_to_title(sex), " (RCT Only)"),
        x = "Estimated 95% CI",
        y = "Age Band"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
      )
    
    list(
      plot = plot,
      data = sex_rct_data
    )
  })
  
  names(rct_output_list) <- sex_groups
  
  # --- 7. Wald tests for comparisons --------------------
  
  # Helper function for Wald test
  wald_test <- function(mean1, mean2, sd1, sd2) {
    wald_result <- (mean1 - mean2) / sqrt(sd1^2 + sd2^2)  
    p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(wald_result)))  
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Sex comparisons (Overall estimates, All studies)
  male_overall <- combined_results %>% 
    filter(sex_group == "male", as.character(age_band) == "Overall", rct_status == "All studies")
  female_overall <- combined_results %>% 
    filter(sex_group == "female", as.character(age_band) == "Overall", rct_status == "All studies")
  
  sex_comparison <- tibble(
    Comparison = "Male vs Female (Overall)",
    `P (Wald Test)` = wald_test(
      male_overall$pooled_estimate,
      female_overall$pooled_estimate,
      male_overall$pooled_sd,
      female_overall$pooled_sd
    )
  )
  
  # RCT vs All studies comparison (Overall)
  rct_comparisons <- purrr::map_dfr(sex_groups, function(sex) {
    all_studies <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == sex, as.character(age_band) == "Overall",
             rct_status == "All studies")
    rct_studies <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == sex, as.character(age_band) == "Overall",
             rct_status == "RCT only")
    
    if (nrow(rct_studies) == 0 || is.na(rct_studies$pooled_estimate)) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    
    tibble(
      `Sex Group` = sex,
      Comparison = "All Studies vs RCT Only",
      `P (Wald Test)` = wald_test(
        all_studies$pooled_estimate,
        rct_studies$pooled_estimate,
        all_studies$pooled_sd,
        rct_studies$pooled_sd
      )
    )
  })
  
  # Age band comparisons within each sex group (All studies)
  age_band_comparisons <- purrr::map_dfr(sex_groups, function(sex) {
    sex_data <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == sex, 
             rct_status == "All studies",
             as.character(age_band) != "Overall",
             as.character(age_band) != "Meta-Regression") %>%
      arrange(age_band)
    
    if (nrow(sex_data) < 2) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    
    # Pairwise comparisons between age bands
    age_bands <- unique(as.character(sex_data$age_band))
    comparisons <- combn(age_bands, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    
    purrr::map_dfr(comparisons, function(pair) {
      data1 <- sex_data %>% filter(as.character(age_band) == pair[1])
      data2 <- sex_data %>% filter(as.character(age_band) == pair[2])
      
      tibble(
        `Sex Group` = sex,
        Comparison = paste0(pair[1], " vs ", pair[2]),
        `P (Wald Test)` = wald_test(
          data1$pooled_estimate,
          data2$pooled_estimate,
          data1$pooled_sd,
          data2$pooled_sd
        )
      )
    })
  })
  
  # Sex comparison within each age band (All studies)
  age_band_sex_comparisons <- purrr::map_dfr(age_bands_main, function(age) {
    male_data <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == "male", rct_status == "All studies",
             as.character(age_band) == as.character(age))
    female_data <- combined_results %>%
      filter(sex_group == "female", rct_status == "All studies",
             as.character(age_band) == as.character(age))
    
    if (nrow(male_data) == 0 || nrow(female_data) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    
    tibble(
      `Age Band` = as.character(age),
      `P (Wald Test)` = wald_test(
        male_data$pooled_estimate,
        female_data$pooled_estimate,
        male_data$pooled_sd,
        female_data$pooled_sd
      )
    )
  })
  
  # Format all comparison tables
  format_wald_table <- function(df) {
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    n_rows <- nrow(df)
    df %>%
      mutate(
        `P (Wald Test)` = case_when(
          `P (Wald Test)` < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
          `P (Wald Test)` < 0.01  ~ "<0.01",
          `P (Wald Test)` < 0.05  ~ "<0.05",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", `P (Wald Test)`)
        )
      ) %>%
      gt() %>%
      cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything()) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = "#f7f7f7"),
        locations = cells_body(rows = seq(1, n_rows, by = 2))
      ) %>%
      tab_options(
        table.font.size = px(11),
        column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
        data_row.padding = px(3)
      )
  }
  
  sex_comparison_gt <- sex_comparison %>%
    format_wald_table() %>%
    tab_header(title = md("**Sex Comparison (Overall)**"))
  
  rct_comparisons_gt <- if (nrow(rct_comparisons) > 0) {
    rct_comparisons %>%
      format_wald_table() %>%
      tab_header(title = md("**All Studies vs RCT Only**"))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  age_band_comparisons_gt <- if (nrow(age_band_comparisons) > 0) {
    age_band_comparisons %>%
      format_wald_table() %>%
      tab_header(title = md("**Age Band Comparisons Within Sex Groups**"))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  age_band_sex_comparisons_gt <- if (nrow(age_band_sex_comparisons) > 0) {
    age_band_sex_comparisons %>%
      format_wald_table() %>%
      tab_header(title = md("**Sex Comparisons Within Age Bands**"))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  # --- 8. Create combined summary table --------------------
  combined_summary_table <- combined_results %>%
    select(-urine_component) %>%
    mutate(
      `Sex Group` = as.character(sex_group),
      `RCT Status` = rct_status,
      `Age Band` = as.character(age_band),
      `95% Range` = ifelse(
        is.na(lower_95) | is.na(upper_95),
        "—",
        sprintf("%.2f – %.2f", lower_95, upper_95)
      ),
      Studies = ifelse(is.na(n_studies), "—", as.character(n_studies)),
      "Study Type" = ifelse(is.na(study_type), "—", study_type),
      Participants = ifelse(is.na(total_participants), "—", as.character(total_participants)),
      I2 = I2 * 100,
      `I²` = ifelse(is.na(I2), "—", paste0(round(I2, 1), "%")),
      `Cochran's Q` = ifelse(is.na(Q), "—", as.character(round(Q, 1))),
      `Q (p-value)` = case_when(
        is.na(Q_pval) ~ "—",
        Q_pval < 0.005 ~ "<0.005",
        Q_pval < 0.01  ~ "<0.01",
        Q_pval < 0.05  ~ "<0.05",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", Q_pval)
      ),
      `Egger's p` = case_when(
        is.na(eggers_p) ~ "—",
        eggers_p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        eggers_p < 0.01  ~ "<0.01",
        eggers_p < 0.05  ~ "<0.05",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", eggers_p)
      ),
      "Model" = ifelse(is.na(model_utilised), "—", model_utilised)
    ) %>%
    select(
      `Sex Group`,
      `RCT Status`,
      `Age Band`,
      `95% Range`,
      Studies,
      "Study Type",
      Participants,
      `I²`,
      `Cochran's Q`,
      `Q (p-value)`,
      `Egger's p`,
      Model
    )
  
  combined_summary_gt <- combined_summary_table %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md("**Combined Meta-Analysis Results**"),
      subtitle = paste0("24-Hour Urine ", urine_component_for_title)
    ) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center") %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    # Highlight by sex group
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "springgreen3"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = `Sex Group` == "main meta-analysis")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "skyblue2"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = `Sex Group` == "male")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "indianred1"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = `Sex Group` == "female")
    ) %>%
    # Bold the Overall rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = everything(),
        rows = `Age Band` == "Overall"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Bold and highlight Meta-Regression rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = everything(),
        rows = `Age Band` == "Meta-Regression"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Highlight RCT only rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#ffffcc"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = `RCT Status` == "RCT only")
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(11),
      heading.title.font.size = px(14),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
      data_row.padding = px(3)
    ) %>%
    tab_source_note(
      source_note = md("*I² represents heterogeneity; Q test assesses between-study variation; Egger's p = linear regression test for funnel plot asymmetry; Meta-Regression shows covariate-adjusted estimates*")
    )

  # --- 9. Create overall comparison plot --------------------
  
  design <- "ABC
             EEE"
  
  # Row 1: Three forest plots 
  row1 <- (
      output_list[["main meta-analysis"]]$plot |
        output_list[["male"]]$plot |
        output_list[["female"]]$plot 
    )
  
  # Row 2: Combined summary table
  row2 <- wrap_elements(full = combined_summary_gt) 
  
  # Combine rows
  final_layout <- row1 + row2 + 
    plot_layout(design = design,
                axis_titles = "collect",
                axes = "collect") + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = urine_component_for_title,
      tag_levels = "A",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
    )
  
  # --- 9b. Create RCT-only comparison plot --------------------
  rct_plots_exist <- !is.null(rct_output_list[["main meta-analysis"]]) ||
                     !is.null(rct_output_list[["male"]]) ||
                     !is.null(rct_output_list[["female"]])
  
  if (rct_plots_exist) {
    rct_plot_list <- list()
    if (!is.null(rct_output_list[["main meta-analysis"]])) {
      rct_plot_list <- c(rct_plot_list, list(rct_output_list[["main meta-analysis"]]$plot))
    }
    if (!is.null(rct_output_list[["male"]])) {
      rct_plot_list <- c(rct_plot_list, list(rct_output_list[["male"]]$plot))
    }
    if (!is.null(rct_output_list[["female"]])) {
      rct_plot_list <- c(rct_plot_list, list(rct_output_list[["female"]]$plot))
    }
    
    # Create RCT summary table
    rct_summary_table <- combined_results %>%
      filter(rct_status == "RCT only") %>%
      select(-urine_component) %>%
      mutate(
        `Sex Group` = as.character(sex_group),
        `Age Band` = as.character(age_band),
        `95% Range` = ifelse(
          is.na(lower_95) | is.na(upper_95),
          "—",
          sprintf("%.2f – %.2f", lower_95, upper_95)
        ),
        Studies = ifelse(is.na(n_studies), "—", as.character(n_studies)),
        "Study Type" = ifelse(is.na(study_type), "—", study_type),
        Participants = ifelse(is.na(total_participants), "—", as.character(total_participants)),
        I2_val = I2 * 100,
        `I²` = ifelse(is.na(I2_val), "—", paste0(round(I2_val, 1), "%")),
        `Cochran's Q` = ifelse(is.na(Q), "—", as.character(round(Q, 1))),
        `Q (p-value)` = case_when(
          is.na(Q_pval) ~ "—",
          Q_pval < 0.005 ~ "<0.005",
          Q_pval < 0.01  ~ "<0.01",
          Q_pval < 0.05  ~ "<0.05",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", Q_pval)
        ),
        `Egger's p` = case_when(
          is.na(eggers_p) ~ "—",
          eggers_p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
          eggers_p < 0.01  ~ "<0.01",
          eggers_p < 0.05  ~ "<0.05",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", eggers_p)
        ),
        "Model" = ifelse(is.na(model_utilised), "—", model_utilised)
      ) %>%
      select(
        `Sex Group`,
        `Age Band`,
        `95% Range`,
        Studies,
        "Study Type",
        Participants,
        `I²`,
        `Cochran's Q`,
        `Q (p-value)`,
        `Egger's p`,
        Model
      )

    rct_summary_gt <- rct_summary_table %>%
      gt() %>%
      tab_header(
        title = md("**RCT-Only Meta-Analysis Results**"),
        subtitle = paste0("24-Hour Urine ", urine_component_for_title)
      ) %>%
      cols_align(align = "center") %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = "springgreen3"),
        locations = cells_body(rows = `Sex Group` == "main meta-analysis")
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = "skyblue2"),
        locations = cells_body(rows = `Sex Group` == "male")
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = "indianred1"),
        locations = cells_body(rows = `Sex Group` == "female")
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = everything(),
          rows = `Age Band` == "Overall"
        )
      ) %>%
      tab_options(
        table.font.size = px(11),
        heading.title.font.size = px(14),
        heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
        column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
        data_row.padding = px(3)
      ) %>%
      tab_source_note(
        source_note = md("*I² represents heterogeneity; Q test assesses between-study variation; Egger's p = linear regression test for funnel plot asymmetry; — indicates insufficient data*")
      )

    if (length(rct_plot_list) == 1) {
      rct_row1 <- rct_plot_list[[1]]
    } else if (length(rct_plot_list) == 2) {
      rct_row1 <- rct_plot_list[[1]] | rct_plot_list[[2]]
    } else {
      rct_row1 <- rct_plot_list[[1]] | rct_plot_list[[2]] | rct_plot_list[[3]]
    }
    
    rct_row2 <- wrap_elements(full = rct_summary_gt)
    
    rct_layout <- rct_row1 + rct_row2 + 
      plot_layout(design = design,
                  axis_titles = "collect",
                  axes = "collect") + 
      plot_annotation(
        title = paste0(urine_component_for_title, " - RCT Only"),
        tag_levels = "A",
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
      )
  } else {
    rct_layout <- NULL
    rct_summary_gt <- NULL
  }
  
  # --- 10. Return results --------------------
  return(list(
    ma_results = combined_results,
    main_meta_analysis = output_list[["main meta-analysis"]],
    male = output_list[["male"]],
    female = output_list[["female"]],
    combined_plot = final_layout,
    combined_summary_table = combined_summary_gt,
    rct_plot = rct_layout,
    rct_summary_table = rct_summary_gt,
    rct_main = rct_output_list[["main meta-analysis"]],
    rct_male = rct_output_list[["male"]],
    rct_female = rct_output_list[["female"]],
    wald_tests = list(
      sex_comparison = sex_comparison_gt,
      rct_comparison = rct_comparisons_gt,
      age_band_comparisons = age_band_comparisons_gt,
      sex_within_age_bands = age_band_sex_comparisons_gt
    )
  ))
}
```
